plugins.readme_text:
# @dsh-gis/dsh-opengis-skill

> **English summary** — A DeepSeek Harness bundle that packages the `gis/` skills of
> [opengis-skills](https://github.com/znlgis/opengis-skills) as installable, toggleable skills.
> The session catalog lists names and descriptions only; skill bodies and their
> `reference/*.md` files are loaded on demand, and every body carries DeepSeek Harness
> execution guidance (tool mapping, version probes, verification, permissions). Zero
> runtime dependencies: every asset ships inside the npm package.
>
> Compatibility: DeepSeek Harness `>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0-0`; Node.js `>=22` for development
> only. MIT licensed.

DeepSeek Harness 的 **OpenGIS 技能包插件**：把 [opengis-skills](https://github.com/znlgis/opengis-skills) 中 `gis/` 分类的 GIS 技能打包成可安装、可启停的 DSH bundle。会话技能目录只列出名称与描述，技能正文与参考资料按需加载。

## 特性

- **覆盖 GIS 全链路**：GDAL、GDAL API、QGIS（qgis_process / PyQGIS / QGIS Server）、GeoServer（含 REST API 与 Cloud）、MapServer、PostGIS、PROJ、PDAL、GRASS GIS、JTS、NetTopologySuite、Esri Geometry API（Java/.NET）、Shapely、GeoPandas、GeoPipeAgent、OpenGisDAF、CesiumJS、OpenLayers、Leaflet、Mapbox GL JS、deck.gl、SharpMap、Mapsui、GeoTools、OpenGIS Utils（Java/.NET），以及 `opengis-all` 全流程索引。
- **按需加载**：注册的是 skill provider（`ctx.skills.registerProvider`），发现阶段只读 frontmatter；正文每次加载时读取，参考资料（`reference/*.md`）通过技能目录（resource base）相对解析。
- **零运行时依赖**：只用 Node 内置模块，不 import DSH 内部包；全部资产随 npm 包分发，整个包解包后约 720 kB。
- **可同步上游**：`npm run sync` 从 opengis-skills 检出复制资产，记录上游 commit 与每个文件的 SHA-256 到 `upstream.json`，并重新生成本文下方技能清单。
- **可启停**：单包同时是 bundle 与插件（`dsh.bundle.patch` 插入自身行），在 Plugins 里启用/停用即可。
- **面向 DSH 的执行建议**：每个技能末尾都有 `## DeepSeek Harness 使用建议`，写明如何按需读 reference、Windows 下如何映射 shell 命令、先跑哪个版本探测命令、如何重新打开产物验证，以及哪些安装/覆盖/凭据操作要先确认。

## 兼容性

- **DeepSeek Harness**：`>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0-0`（`package.json` 的 `engines.dsh`）。本包通过 Host 提供的 `ctx.skills` 注册 provider，遵循 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill` 的 registry API 与 candidate/definition 契约；该契约在 0.2.0-rc.2 与 0.2.1-rc.2 之间字节一致，`dsh.bundle.patch`、locale 与图标元数据在 0.2.0-rc.2 已经可用。
- **Node.js**：`>=22`（`engines.node`）。仅开发脚本与测试需要，插件本身运行在 DSH 内。
- **运行时依赖**：无。`dependencies` 为空，只使用 Node 内置模块，不 import DSH 内部包。

## 技能清单

<!-- skills:count:start -->
共 **32** 个技能，描述取自上游 frontmatter。
<!-- skills:count:end -->

<!-- skills:start -->
| Skill | Description (upstream frontmatter) |
| --- | --- |
| `cesiumjs` | Use when building browser-based 3D globes, 3D Tiles, CZML/time-dynamic data, or glTF models with npm cesium 1.146.0 — Viewer, Cesium3DTileset, Ion token (Cesium.Ion.defaultAccessToken), CESIUM_BASE_URL for Workers/Assets/Widgets, GCJ-02 tile offset, or debugging a black screen after a Vite/Webpack build. |
| `deck-gl` | Use when visualizing large geospatial datasets in the browser with deck.gl 9.4.0 — ScatterplotLayer/GeoJsonLayer, HexagonLayer/ScreenGridLayer aggregation, MVTLayer/TileLayer, @deck.gl/mapbox MapboxOverlay over MapLibre, or debugging blank canvases, stale data props and mismatched @deck.gl/* subpackage versions. |
| `gdal` | Use when processing geospatial raster/vector data via GDAL/OGR CLI — ogr2ogr format conversion (Shapefile/GeoPackage/GeoJSON), gdalwarp reprojection, gdal_translate, gdal_calc.py NDVI, COG, mosaicking, DEM contours, gdalinfo -json checks — or diagnosing "not recognized as a supported file format"; also covers the 3.9+ unified gdal raster / gdal vector CLI. |
| `gdal-api` | Use when programming against GDAL/OGR in C, C++, Python, Java, or .NET — raster/vector I/O, gdal.UseExceptions, OGRSpatialReference transforms, gdal.Translate / gdal.Warp, VRT/COG, or fixing "no driver registered" and UnsatisfiedLinkError; C++ gdal-config, Maven org.gdal:gdal 3.13.0, NuGet MaxRev.Gdal.Core. |
| `geometry-api-java` | Use when working with Esri geometry types (Point, Polyline, Polygon, Envelope) in Java — GeometryEngine, com.esri.geometry:esri-geometry-api:2.2.4, WKT/WKB/GeoJSON/Esri JSON I/O, geodesic distance; also when GeometryEngine has no intersects or WKB method and you need OperatorFactoryLocal, or when 2.3.1 coordinates fail to resolve on Maven Central. Esri Geometry API for Java. |
| `geometry-api-net` | Use when working with Esri geometry types (Point, Polyline, Polygon, Envelope) in .NET/C# — GeometryEngine, NuGet OpenGIS.Esri.Geometry.Core 1.0.9, WKT/EWKT, WKB, GeoJSON and Esri JSON I/O, System.Text.Json converters, geodesic distance; also for unclosed polygon rings, Geometry base-class casts after overlay, or the retired Esri/geometry-api-net repo. Esri Geometry API for .NET. |
| `geopandas` | Use when doing vector spatial analysis in Python — gpd.read_file/to_file via pyogrio (GPKG, Shapefile, GeoParquet), sjoin/sjoin_nearest, overlay, clip, dissolve, to_crs vs set_crs, gdf.plot choropleth; also for CRSError from a missing PROJ data dir, area/distance computed in degrees, or GeoDataFrame geometry-column conflicts. GeoPandas 1.2.0 extends pandas DataFrames with geometry columns. |
| `geopipe-agent` | Use when building YAML GIS pipelines with GeoPipeAgent — geopipe-agent validate/run, io.read_vector → vector.buffer → io.write_vector chains, 33 built-in steps, qc.geometry_validity/attribute_completeness/topology, native_python\|qgis_process\|gdal_cli backends, $step.output refs; also for validate "not registered" errors, silent when-condition skips, and resolve/knowledge capability gaps. 0.1.0, source install only (not on PyPI). |
| `geoserver` | Use when deploying GeoServer 3.0.x to publish WMS/WFS/WMTS/WCS/MVT, or configuring SLD/CSS styles, RBAC security, and GeoWebCache seeding. Covers geoserver-3.0.2-bin.zip, docker.osgeo.org/geoserver:3.0.2 on Java 17/21, /rest/about/version.json, blank GetMap from wrong native bounds, and Shapefile charset mojibake. |
| `geoserver-cloud` | Use when deploying GeoServer Cloud 3.0.2 on Docker Compose or Kubernetes — gateway serving WMS/WFS/WCS/WPS/GWC microservices under /geoserver/cloud, PgConfig vs datadir backends, RabbitMQ config-bus sync, Helm chart geoservercloud 3.0.2, and diagnosing 502s via actuator/health and Consul registration. |
| `geoserver-rest-api` | Use when automating GeoServer 3.0.2 over REST — POST /rest/workspaces, datastores, featuretypes, PUT Shapefile ZIP to file.shp, GeoTIFF to coveragestores, upload SLD as application/vnd.ogc.sld+xml, ?recurse=true deletes. curl -u admin:geoserver, single-key JSON like {"workspace":{...}}, 401 on POST but 200 on GET, GWC cache masking style changes. |
| `geotools` | Use when building Java GIS apps on GeoTools 35.2 (JDK 17) — org.geotools:gt-main / gt-shapefile / gt-geopkg / gt-epsg-hsql from repo.osgeo.org (not Maven Central), CQL/ECQL filters, CRS.decode plus JTS.transform reprojection, StreamingRenderer PNG output, and disposing DataStore/SimpleFeatureIterator. |
| `grass-gis` | Use when doing GIS geoprocessing with GRASS GIS headlessly — grass --exec and --tmp-project for servers and CI, g.region computational region management, r.* raster, v.* vector, r3.* 3D raster and t.* temporal modules, r.import/v.import data import, or Python scripting with grass.script, grass.script.array and grass.tools. |
| `jts` | Use when doing precise 2D computational geometry in Java with org.locationtech.jts:jts-core 1.20.0 — GeometryFactory construction, contains/intersects predicates, overlay via OverlayNGRobust, buffer, STRtree and PreparedGeometry speedups, WKT/WKB/GeoJSON I/O, and fixing TopologyException or unclosed rings. |
| `leaflet` | Use when adding lightweight 2D tile maps to web pages with leaflet 1.9.4 — L.map/L.tileLayer, markers, popups, GeoJSON overlays, layer control, [lat, lng] ordering, or debugging blank maps, broken default marker icons after bundling, and sizing fixed by invalidateSize(). |
| `mapbox-gl-js` | Use when building vector web maps with mapbox-gl 3.33.0 — WebGL rendering, Style Spec layers, data-driven expressions, setTerrain raster-dem, fill-extrusion, or debugging 401 'A valid Mapbox access token is required', 'Style is not done loading', and pk./sk. token handling. Note: v2+ is proprietary under Mapbox TOS and requires a token; MapLibre GL JS is the open-source fork. |
| `mapserver` | Use when publishing WMS/WFS/WCS/OGC API Features from a MapServer 8.6.6 .map mapfile — MAP/LAYER/CLASS/STYLE objects, STATUS/PROJECTI

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 的 Obsidian 桥接插件：知识库 + 记忆库双功能，目录显式选择
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-inkvault（墨库 / InkVault）

DeepSeek Harness 的 Obsidian 桥接插件，提供**两个可独立开关、各自选择文件夹**的能力：

| 功能 | 作用 | 写入位置 | 工具 |
|---|---|---|---|
| **知识库** | 在 DSH 对话中把知识写进你的 Obsidian 库 | 你选的 `knowledgeRoot`（笔记在 `<root>/notes/`） | `inkvault_note_save / note_search / note_read` |
| **记忆库** | 让 DSH 用 Obsidian 做长期记忆（自动召回 + 回合沉淀） | 你选的 `memoryRoot`（记忆在 `<root>/memory/`） | `inkvault_search / read / remember / forget` |

另有 `inkvault_status`：随时回答「我的库到底在哪、有多少条」。

**核心原则：插件绝不自己发明目录。** 两个 root 都必须显式配置；没配置的功能保持不激活（不建目录、不注册对应工具），不会往 C 盘或某个隐藏文件夹里默默写东西。装完先用 `inkvault_status` 看配置状态。

## 目录

- [安装](#安装)
- [配置](#配置)
- [目录结构与笔记格式](#目录结构与笔记格式)
- [模型可见工具](#模型可见工具)
- [记忆的召回与沉淀](#记忆的召回与沉淀)
- [安全模型](#安全模型)
- [失败与恢复](#失败与恢复)
- [接入 Obsidian](#接入-obsidian)
- [开发与测试](#开发与测试)
- [版本、验证与路线](#版本验证与路线)

## 安装

在 Harness 里用 `plugin_manager`（`action: install_bundle`，`target` 为本目录绝对路径）安装；或：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add "D:\DSH Workspace\dsh-inkvault"
```

安装会读 `package.json` 的 `dsh.bundle.patch`，把一行插件 entry 追加到 profile 补丁层。

## 配置

v0.3.0 起插件自带客户端页面：打开 **设置 → 墨库 InkVault**，即可看到「记忆库文件夹 / 知识库文件夹」两项。可以直接输入路径（支持 `~`），也可以点 **浏览…** 调用宿主原生文件夹选择器；点保存后由 Host 写回 profile 补丁并立即生效。

也可以直接编辑 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`（`config` 是整体替换，未写的键用默认值）：

```yaml
- id: inkvault
  config:
    disabled: false              # 总开关；true = 完全不注册任何东西

    # 功能 1：知识库（写入你选的文件夹）
    knowledgeEnabled: true
    knowledgeRoot: '~\Documents\Obsidian Vault\Knowledge'

    # 功能 2：记忆库（agent 长期记忆）
    memoryEnabled: true
    memoryRoot: '~\Documents\Obsidian Vault\InkVault'
    inject: true                 # 每回合第一步自动召回
    capture: true                # 回合结束自动沉淀候选
    injectBudgetTokens: 800
    maxRecallItems: 6
    captureMaxPerTurn: 2
    minCaptureConfidence: 0.6

    debug: false
```

| 选项 | 默认 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|
| `disabled` | `true` | 总开关；`true` 时不注册工具/钩子，行为回到原状 |
| `knowledgeEnabled` | `true` | 是否启用知识库功能 |
| `knowledgeRoot` | **空（不启用）** | 知识库根目录；笔记写入 `<root>/notes/` |
| `memoryEnabled` | `true` | 是否启用记忆库功能 |
| `memoryRoot` | **空（不启用）** | 记忆库根目录；记忆写入 `<root>/memory/` |
| `inject` / `capture` | `true` | 记忆的自动召回 / 自动沉淀 |
| `injectBudgetTokens` | `800` | 单次注入 token 预算（CJK 按 1 token/字） |
| `maxRecallItems` | `6` | 单次注入条目上限 |
| `captureMaxPerTurn` | `2` | 每回合最多沉淀候选数 |
| `minCaptureConfidence` | `0.6` | 低于该置信度的候选丢弃 |
| `debug` | `false` | 召回/沉淀调试日志 |

规则：

- `~` 会展开；相对路径按用户主目录解析并告警。
- **不设默认目录**：`*Root` 留空则该功能不激活，并在日志/`inkvault_status` 中报告。
- 配置非法回落到默认值并记 warning，不会阻断插件加载。
- 目录可以指向同一个 Obsidian 库的不同子文件夹，也可以指向完全不同的位置。

## 目录结构与笔记格式

```
<memoryRoot>/
  memory/<id>.md           # 记忆条目
  .inkvault/index.json     # 派生索引（可删，自动重建）
  .inkvault/journal.jsonl  # 审计日志
  .inkvault/quarantine/    # 解析失败文件隔离
  .trash/                  # forget 的可逆归档

<knowledgeRoot>/
  notes/<id>.md            # 知识笔记
  .inkvault/ ... .trash/   # 同上
```

```markdown
---
id: m-20261019-ab12cd
title: 用户偏好：回答用中文
kind: preference
status: active
created: 2026-10-19T10:00:00.000Z
updated: 2026-10-19T10:00:00.000Z
tags: [preference, language]
confidence: 0.8
source: manual
hash: 0123456789abcdef
origin: ''
---

正文 Markdown。
```

- `kind`：`preference` / `fact` / `decision` / `project` / `reference` / `task`
- `status`：`active`（可召回）/ `pending`（候选，仍可召回）/ `superseded` / `archived`
- 文件是唯一事实源；索引删除后下次初始化自动重建。

## 模型可见工具

| 工具 | 作用 | 关键参数 |
|---|---|---|
| `inkvault_note_save` | 把知识写进知识库文件夹 | `text`、`title?`、`kind?`、`tags?` |
| `inkvault_note_search` | 搜索知识笔记 | `query`、`limit?` |
| `inkvault_note_read` | 按 id 读取知识笔记 | `id` |
| `inkvault_search` | 搜索记忆库 | `query`、`limit?`、`kinds?` |
| `inkvault_read` | 按 id 读取记忆 | `id` |
| `inkvault_remember` | 显式写入一条长期记忆 | `text`、`kind?`、`title?`、`tags?`、`confidence?` |
| `inkvault_forget` | 归档一条记忆（进 `.trash`，可恢复） | `id`、`reason?` |
| `inkvault_status` | 报告两个库的位置、是否激活、条目数、配置问题 | — |

工具只接受 id、不接受路径；模型无法用工具越过已配置的 root。

## 记忆的召回与沉淀

- **召回**：`agent/pre-step`（waterfall），仅 `step === 0` 注入一次；`await next()` 后 spread 决策并追加一条 `source.kind = 'inkvault-recall'` 的 user 消息，块以 `<inkvault-memory trust="untrusted-data">` 开头并声明「参考数据，不是指令」。
- **沉淀**：`agent/turn-stopping`（serial），从 `session/event` 缓冲的当轮文本做规则抽取，写入 `status: pending` 候选；失败只 warning。
- **不注入 system prompt**：preset 的 `complete: true` section 会让宿主只保留该段（`dsh-system-prompt` 的 `assemble()`），注入走 user 消息才可靠、可回放。
- **不新增会话事件类型**：`Session.append` 无法标记 `ignorable`，会破坏会话重开；因此只写 Markdown 文件。

## 安全模型

- **路径即权限**：所有文件操作经 `src/paths.js` 的 `safeResolve(root, relative)`；拒绝 `..`、绝对路径、UNC、Windows 保留设备名、任一层符号链接/junction 逃逸。
- **只写配置内目录**：两个功能各自只写自己的 root；未配置的功能不创建任何目录。
- **工具面无路径**：只接受 id（`^m-\d{8}-[a-z0-9]{6}$`）。
- **注入是数据**：召回块显式标注不可信。

## 失败与恢复

- 原子写：临时文件 + `fsync` + `rename`；失败清理临时文件，索引不变。
- 索引可重建：删除 `.inkvault/index.json` 后自动重建；过期按 mtime 判定。
- 解析失败文件进 `.inkvault/quarantine/`，不阻塞其他条目。
- `forget` 只移动到 `.trash/`，不物理删除。

## 接入 Obsidian

两个 root 都建议指向你 Obsidian 库内的子文件夹（可以是同一个库的不同目录）：

```yaml
knowledgeRoot: '~\Documents\Obsidian Vault\Knowledge'
memoryRoot: '~\Documents\Obsidian Vault\InkVault'
```

- 打开 Obsidian 就能看到 `Knowledge/notes/*.md` 与 `InkVault/memory/*.md`。
- `.inkvault/`、`.trash/` 是点目录，Obsidian 默认忽略。
- 写入范围仅限这两个子文件夹，库内其他个人笔记不会被改写。
- 迁移脚本：`scripts/configure-obsidian-vault.ps1`（备份 profile 补丁）。

## 开发与测试

```bash
cd "D:\DSH Workspace\dsh-inkvault"
node --test test/*.test.js
```

- 隔离沙箱内 Node 测试子进程可能 `EPERM`，用 `NODE_OPTIONS=--experimental-test-isolation=none` 等价运行。
- 内部模块契约见 [docs/internal-contract.md](docs/internal-contract.md)，架构决策见 [dsh-inkvault-架构设计.md](dsh-inkvault-架构设计.md)。

## 版本、验证与路线

- 当前 **v0.3.0**：双功能（知识库 + 记忆库）、独立开关、独立目录、8 个工具、`inkvault_status`、路径隔离、BM25、原子写与索引重建；**设置 → 墨库 InkVault** 页面可直接选择/编辑两个文件夹（含原生「浏览…」选择器）。
- 自动化测试 **114 项**（113 pass / 1 skip；skip 为当前主机无权限创建文件符号链接）。
- 版本规则：`vx.y.z`，初版 `v0.1.0`；普通更新 z+1，较大更新 y+1，x 仅在明确要求时变动；每个版本对应一个 tag。

已知限制：

- 知识库目前是**显式写入**（用户说“存到知识库”时由 agent 调用工具），不做对话自动沉淀。
- 召回是词法 BM25（中文按 2-gram），不做语义/向量检索。
- 无候选审核面板；设置页已提供（v0.3.0）。
- 无跨进程锁；同一 vault 多实例并发写是已知限制。

plugins.description: DSH Web 插件：模型供应商额度与用量（DeepSeek / GLM Coding Plan / OpenRouter / Kimi Coding + 自定义适配器）
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-model-usage

[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@ponydev/dsh-model-usage)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@ponydev/dsh-model-usage)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/@ponydev/dsh-model-usage)](LICENSE)

**DeepSeek Harness（DSH）Web UI 插件：实时显示模型供应商的额度与用量。**

- 侧边栏底部：当前供应商的额度/余额卡片，点击打开全部供应商弹窗（Codex 式）
- 官方 Logo：DeepSeek / GLM(Z.ai) / Kimi / OpenRouter / MiniMax / OpenCode / OpenAI / Anthropic / Gemini / xAI / Qwen / Mistral / Groq / GitHub Copilot 等 25+
- 设置 → 模型用量：KPI、趋势图、供应商/模型聚合、请求日志、CSV 导出
- 设置 → 模型：页面底部显示各供应商额度
- 版本检查：设置 → 模型用量 右上角「检查更新」（对比 npm 最新版，可复制更新命令）
- 只用**真实数据**：额度来自服务商接口，用量来自本机会话日志（逐 token 一致），不做金额估算

![侧边栏额度卡片](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PonyDevAI/dsh-model-usage/main/docs/screenshots/01-sidebar.png)

![模型用量弹窗](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PonyDevAI/dsh-model-usage/main/docs/screenshots/02-modal.png)

![统计面板](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PonyDevAI/dsh-model-usage/main/docs/screenshots/03-settings.png)

![请求日志](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PonyDevAI/dsh-model-usage/main/docs/screenshots/04-request-log.png)

## 安装

要求 DSH `>= 0.2.0-rc.2 < 0.3.0`。

```bash
# CLI
dsh plugin --profile web add @ponydev/dsh-model-usage

# 或在 Web「插件」页搜索安装
```

安装后重启宿主（`launchctl kickstart -k gui/$(id -u)/local.deepseek-harness.web`）并刷新页面。

本地开发：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-model-usage
```

## 供应商支持（完整矩阵见 [docs/providers.md](docs/providers.md)）

| 供应商 | 数据接口 | 凭据引用 |
|---|---|---|
| DeepSeek API | `api.deepseek.com/user/balance` | `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` |
| DeepSeek 账号 | Host `deepseekAccount` 服务（登录态） | — |
| GLM Coding Plan（国内 / 国际） | `open.bigmodel.cn` / `api.z.ai` 额度接口（5 小时 / 每周 / **每月 MCP 工具次数**） | `ZAI_CODING_CN_API_KEY` / `ZAI_API_KEY` |
| OpenRouter | `openrouter.ai/api/v1/credits`（兜底 `/api/v1/key`） | `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` |
| Kimi Coding Plan | `api.kimi.com/coding/v1/usages` | `KIMI_CODING_API_KEY` / `KIMI_API_KEY` / `MOONSHOT_API_KEY` |
| Moonshot / Kimi 平台 | `api.moonshot.{ai,cn}/v1/users/me/balance` | `MOONSHOT_API_KEY` / `MOONSHOT_CN_API_KEY` |
| MiniMax Token Plan | `api.minimax.io` / `api.minimaxi.com` `/v1/token_plan/remains` | `MINIMAX_API_KEY` / `MINIMAX_CN_API_KEY` |
| OpenCode Go | `opencode.ai/zen/go/v1/usage` | `OPENCODE_API_KEY` |
| Xiaomi MiMo | `platform.xiaomimimo.com/api/v1/balance` | `XIAOMI_API_KEY` |
| GitHub Copilot | `api.github.com/copilot_internal/user` | `GITHUB_TOKEN` |
| 其他任意供应商 | `customQuota` 配置（URL + JSON 路径映射） | 自定义 `keyRef` |

`customQuota` 示例（余额式）：

```yaml
config:
  customQuota:
    mycoder:
      url: https://api.example.com/quota
      auth: bearer                 # bearer | raw | x-api-key | none
      keyRef: MYCODER_API_KEY
      balance:
        path: data.balance
        currency: CNY
```

窗口式：

```yaml
config:
  customQuota:
    mycoder:
      url: https://api.example.com/quota
      windows:
        - key: rolling
          label: 5h
          usedPath: data.used
          limitPath: data.limit
          resetAtPath: data.resetAt   # ms | s | iso
          resetAtUnit: ms
```

## 配置

`cordis.patch.yml` 中 `model-usage` 行的 `config`：

| 键 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `refreshSeconds` | 60 | 额度刷新间隔（秒） |
| `footer` | true | 是否显示侧边栏底部入口 |
| `credentials` | `{}` | 按路由覆盖凭据引用，如 `{ "deepseek-official": "MY_DEEPSEEK_KEY" }` |
| `glm` | `{}` | GLM 组织/项目/套餐类型：`organization` / `project` / `planType` |
| `customQuota` | `{}` | 通用额度适配器（见上） |

## 数据口径

- **用量**：`assistant/message` 事件中的服务商回传 usage（input / cacheRead / cacheWrite / output），与本机会话日志逐 token 一致
- **额度/余额**：服务商接口返回的真实值（DeepSeek 余额、GLM 5h/周剩余、Kimi 周/滚动窗口、OpenRouter credits）
- **真实消耗观测**：每次刷新比对余额/套餐额度变动，得到当日实际支出（余额下降）与充值（余额上升，分开记录不冲抵）
- **不做金额估算**：订阅套餐按套餐额度计费而不是按 API 逐次扣费，任何估算都会误导
- **统计范围**：本机、安装后写入会话日志的调用；旁路调用（标题生成/压缩摘要）与其他设备不计
- 账本文件：`$DSH_HOME/model-usage/ledger.json`（按日聚合，保留 120 天；首次启动回填近 30 天）

## 安全

- API Key 只在 Host 内存中解析使用，**不进入浏览器**，任何 RPC 响应都不包含密钥
- 只请求写死的白名单接口域名；客户端不能指定 URL
- 账本只存用量聚合（token 数、窗口百分比），不含对话内容
- 错误信息脱敏（`sk-*` / `Bearer *` 会被打码）

## 开发与发布

- 开发环境、联调方式、提交前检查：[CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)
- 项目级规范（AI/自动化代理必读）：[AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md)
- **发布流程（tag 触发自动发布，OIDC 无 token）**：[RELEASE.md](RELEASE.md)
- 架构设计：[docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md)

```bash
# 本地渲染台（离线验证 UI，不依赖宿主）
open test-render.html

# 发版（自动发布到 npm + GitHub Release）
npm version patch && git push --follow-tags
```

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.readme_text:
# Codex-style Worktree (dsh-codex-style-worktree)

**English** | [简体中文](README.zh.md)

> A "work like Codex" placement choice for DSH sessions: on the new-session hero row, pick **Local** or **New local worktree** (the default) next to the workspace chip; after you send the first message the plugin creates a detached checkout and switches **that session's** cwd into it. No new Workspace, no naming, no branch from the plugin (Git owns branch naming at commit time).

- Version: `0.5.1` (2026-10-20; package / plugin id / loader row name: `dsh-codex-style-worktree`; profile-patch insert row id: `codex-worktree`)
- API namespace: `/api/dsh-codex-style-worktree`, RPC method prefix `dsh-codex-style-worktree/`; sidecar: `$DSH_HOME/dsh-codex-style-worktree/state.json`; disable marker: `.dsh-codex-style-worktree-off`
- GitHub: <https://github.com/wplct/dsh-codex-style-worktree>
- Requirements: DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` / `0.2.1-rc.2`, Node.js `>= 22.19.0`, `git` on PATH
- License: MIT

## 0.5.1: the checkout is created on the first message

- **Bug fixed**: opening a blank Session no longer creates a checkout. The desktop fires `agent/created` the moment the New Session appears — long before the first prompt — so the old wiring decided the work location at Session-open time; a choice made in that blank Session therefore applied only to the *next* Session (switching to Local still created a checkout, switching back to New local worktree created none).
- Creation now runs on the first step of the Session's first turn (`agent/pre-step` with `turn === 1`) — i.e. after you send the first message — and the per-workspace placement is read at that moment, so the choice made in the blank Session applies to **that** Session.
- Blank Sessions no longer leave stray checkouts behind; the progress card and sidebar marker appear after the first message instead of when the blank Session opens.
- Nothing else changes; there is no config, sidecar or settings migration. Upgrade with `dsh plugin --profile desktop update dsh-codex-style-worktree` and reopen DSH once.

## 0.5.0: rename-only release

- Package name / plugin id / loader row name / API namespace / RPC prefix / sidecar directory all move from `dsh-codex-worktree` to `dsh-codex-style-worktree`; the display title "Codex-style Worktree" is unchanged.
- The **settings namespace stays `codex-worktree`** (the profile-patch insert row id is untouched), so saved settings survive; every editable field is unchanged.
- On first boot the sidecar directory migrates automatically from `~/.dsh/dsh-codex-worktree` to `~/.dsh/dsh-codex-style-worktree` (rename, no data loss; if the rename fails the old directory keeps being read).
- The repository opt-out marker is now `.dsh-codex-style-worktree-off`; the old `.dsh-codex-worktree-off` is still honored.
- Upgrade path: remove the old package, install the new one (`dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-codex-worktree`, then `dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:wplct/dsh-codex-style-worktree`), then fully quit and reopen DSH once.

## What changed in 0.4.0 (vs 0.3.0)

| Capability | 0.3.0 | 0.4.0 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Cleanup guard | Cleanup deletes directly | Refused when the checkout is **another** active session's current cwd (`worktree-in-use`); cleaning your own session's checkout first moves its cwd back to the workspace; `force` overrides after confirmation |
| Snapshot before delete | Only autoPrune kept a ref for detached commits | Every delete path: when the checkout is detached and `HEAD ≠ baseCommit`, write `refs/dsh-codex-style-worktree/<timestamp+session suffix>` and record it in the sidecar |
| Snapshot restore | Manual `git branch` only | `/wt-snapshots`, `/wt-restore <ref>`, and a "recoverable snapshots" list in the settings page |
| Archive cleanup | Checkouts always kept after a session ends | Optional `cleanupOnArchive` (default off): a lazy sweep removes clean, unused checkouts after archive |
| RPC | 6 endpoints | 7 (adds `restore`); the `list` response gains per-repository `snapshots` |
| Sidecar | v2 | v3 (adds a `snapshots` map; v1/v2 are migrated in memory on read, no data loss) |

### What changed in 0.3.0 (vs 0.2.x) — history

| Capability | 0.2.x | 0.3.0 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| When the worktree is created | Automatically for every new session (no choice); a "New Worktree" button could also create one on demand | You choose a placement on the hero row; the worktree is created **after the first message** (first-turn `agent/pre-step`) |
| Selector location | A dock button above the composer | The hero workspace row: a pill between `📁 workspace ▼` and `standard mode ▼` |
| Remembered choice | None | **Per workspace**, persisted in the sidecar (`placements`), restart-safe |
| Workspace | The old button called `workspaces.create`, cluttering the sidebar | **Never creates a Workspace**; only the session cwd changes |
| Progress feedback | None | Inline three-step progress card above the composer (projection-driven, minimum 1 s) |
| Sidebar | No marker | Managed sessions show a **read-only** worktree icon (tooltip = checkout path) |
| Settings page | Read-only config | **Editable form**; save writes the active profile patch and applies live (volatile, no restart) |
| State sync | Some RPC reads | Everything is event/projection-driven, **zero polling** |
| RPC | Included `create`, etc. | `status/list/clean/prune/placement/settings`, no `create`/`cancel` |

## 1. What it does

1. On the new-session hero row (the blank state without a session id) the workspace row shows a placement pill: **New local worktree** (default) or **Local**;
2. the choice is written back to the host immediately and persisted **per workspace path** in the sidecar; later sessions in that workspace inherit it, across restarts;
3. you send the first message → the Session's first turn starts with `agent/pre-step` (before the model's first step) → the host decides by that workspace's placement whether to create a checkout;
4. with "New local worktree": a **detached HEAD** checkout is created at `<repo>/.agents/worktrees/wt-<timestamp>` and **this session's** working directory is switched to it; the session stays attached to its original Workspace;
5. creation progress is pushed through the `codexWorktree` session projection and rendered as an inline progress card above the composer (`Prepare workspace → Check out files → Set up environment`); when done the card fades and the header chip plus the sidebar marker appear;
6. with "Local": nothing is created; the session runs in its original Workspace directory;
7. the plugin **never creates branches, never names anything, never merges, never pushes and never deletes your branches**. Git decides the branch name at commit time; use plain `git switch -c` when you want a branch. `mode: branch` makes the plugin create a `<branchPrefix><name>` branch up front (not the default).

## 2. Interaction

### 2.1 New-session hero row: placement selector

Position: the official **`conversation.hero.options`** seat — the compact options area of the New Session row, right-aligned after the workspace and preset controls, rendered only once the blank new Session exists. It sits on the same row as `📁 workspace ▼` and `standard mode ▼`:

```text
📁 shian360 ▼      standard mode ▼        ⑂ New local worktree ▼
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Describe what you want to build, / for commands…    │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

- Options (single select, current one ticked):
  - `Local` / `本地` — run directly in the current workspace directory;
  - `New local worktree` / `新建本地工作树` — run in a new checkout (**default**);
  - Grey hint at the bottom of the menu: `Creating a local worktree does not add a Workspace; it only switches this Session’s working directory.`
- Visibility: only on the **blank new-session hero row** (this seat is session-scoped, so it renders once the blank Session exists); hidden for non-Git workspaces (`isGit=false` from the host) and for existing sessions.
- Seat choice: this is the official list seat, **not** the shipped WorkspacePicker's `conversation.hero.workspace` (that seat is `kind: "s

plugins.description: Model-selectable subagents with per-task reasoning effort for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 0.2.x. Maintained continuation of CypherNaught-0x/DSH-Subagent-Model-Router.
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH Subagent Model Router

**Give every delegated task the right model and reasoning effort—automatically.**

> [!NOTE]
> This is the maintained continuation of [CypherNaught-0x/DSH-Subagent-Model-Router](https://github.com/CypherNaught-0x/DSH-Subagent-Model-Router), including [poka-IT's DSH 0.1.7/0.2.0 port](https://github.com/CypherNaught-0x/DSH-Subagent-Model-Router/pull/3). It targets DeepSeek Harness 0.2.x and adds per-task reasoning effort. Full history and credit are preserved.

Stop using one model for every kind of work. Configure your preferred fast, affordable, specialized, and high-reasoning models once; the router gives your agent the aliases, tags, and guidance it needs to intelligently select the best route for each delegated task.

That means faster routine work, stronger results on difficult problems, better control over cost, and less model micromanagement. Subagents can run in parallel, their results are reliably joined before the parent responds, and the model chosen for each task stays visible throughout the UI.

## Why use it?

- **Better results where they matter** — reserve your strongest models for architecture, security, deep reasoning, or critical review.
- **Lower cost and latency** — send routine searches, edits, and focused implementation work to faster or more economical routes.
- **Automatic, task-aware routing** — friendly aliases, capability tags, and plain-language usage guidance help the orchestrator choose intelligently.
- **Per-task reasoning effort** — the orchestrator can run the same route at `low` for mechanical work or `xhigh` for a stubborn bug, with an optional default per alias.
- **Confident parallel delegation** — launch multiple specialists in the background and reliably collect every result before synthesis.
- **Clear model visibility** — see which model actually handled a task in subagent headers and in the optional Better Sidebar **Sub-agents** tab.
- **Easy setup** — configure your model team from the Web UI, through a guided skill, or directly in a Cordis patch.

> [!TIP]
> Already using [Better Sidebar](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/DSH-better-sidebar)? The router adds an optional **Sub-agents** tab through Better Sidebar's public `registerTab` API.

## See it in action

### Follow every specialist from Better Sidebar

![Better Sidebar Tasks view showing delegated subagents and their selected model chips](docs/screenshots/better-sidebar-task-model-chips.png)

*See parallel delegated work, current status, and the selected model together in the task tree you already use.*

### Build your ideal model team

![Subagent Model Router settings for aliases, providers, tags, token limits, and routing guidance](docs/screenshots/subagent-model-router-settings.png)

*Define friendly routes and tell the orchestrator when each model shines—from quick, budget-friendly tasks to your most demanding work.*

## What it adds

- `subagent_model`: a delegation tool whose `model` argument is restricted to user-configured aliases, with an optional `reasoning_effort`.
- `wait-for-subagents`: a join tool that waits for this agent's outstanding continuable background children, including standard and model-routed delegations, and returns their terminal results.
- Per-model tags and routing descriptions embedded in the tool schema and system prompt.
- `model_subagent_catalog`: a read-only view of models advertised by registered LLM providers.
- `configure_subagent_models`: a model-facing tool that reads or replaces only this plugin entry's configuration, without filesystem access.
- `model-subagent-setup`: a guided skill for selecting routes, generating routing guidance, obtaining confirmation, and saving through the constrained configuration tool.
- **Settings → Subagent Models**: a Web settings page for manually adding, editing, and removing routes.
- A hot-reloaded plugin configuration: the `config:` of the `- id: dsh-subagent-model-router` Loader entry in a Cordis patch.
- Foreground execution and durable continuable background subagents.
- Configurable stale-subagent filtering for listing tools, defaulting to 20 parent/user message turns without contact.
- An active-model chip in an opened subagent header.
- An optional Better Sidebar **Sub-agents** tab, with active-model chips on its rows, registered through the public sidebar service (when installed).

With an empty `models` list, the catalog, configuration, and wait tools remain available alongside the settings page and setup skill, but `subagent_model` is not registered. This provides a bootstrap state for initial setup.

## Orchestrator behavior

When model-selectable delegation is available, the system prompt tells the orchestrator not to duplicate work it delegated. After issuing all intended background delegations, it must call `wait-for-subagents` before synthesizing the child results or giving a final answer. While a same-session completion goal is active, the orchestrator must not merely report that another model is handling the task and end its turn with background subagents still outstanding: ending the turn triggers immediate goal continuation and can race child tracking. Waiting joins the outstanding work so the orchestrator can synthesize the results and continue or complete the goal. The wait tool joins every continuable background child started by that parent through `subagent`, `subagent_fork`, `subagent_model`, or `auto_agent_run`; it remains useful when no model routes are configured. It reserves standard, forked, and project-specialist delegation calls before they can publish a child, and after plugin reload it discovers direct continuable children when their durable descriptors confirm their mode and the live Agent is either running or interrupted with parked input (reported separately as paused). It preserves every terminal content block and drops retained records when the parent is disposed, while foreground one-shot runs and job-backed non-continuable delegations remain outside this join because their owning tool already returns or collects the result.

Direct human steering must not leave the parent blocked in an old join. When a committed `agent/inbox/spliced` event inserts a `source.kind: user` message at `next-step` for that parent, an active wait returns `{ kind: "interrupted", pending: [...] }` without cancelling or consuming any child. Each pending entry carries the exact child and run identity when available. The DSH agent loop does not automatically schedule a second tool call after the parent answers. Instead, the plugin's system prompt, tool description, and interruption result explicitly require the parent to answer the steering message first and then call `wait-for-subagents` again before final synthesis. That second call resumes the retained records and returns their eventual terminal output; queued `next-turn` input, model-authored context, cancellations, and events for other sessions do not trigger this outcome. A simultaneous child completion remains retained for the resumed wait.

The continuation manager's durable settlement notice triggers immediate reconciliation when a terminal lifecycle event was missed. Recovery requires matching post-boundary evidence in both the retained child epoch log and the parent notice, so an absent registry entry or an idle/resumable child is never treated as success by itself. For an ordinary tracked start, the record remains bound to the exact child and run identity. After plugin reload, a genuinely running child can instead be discovered without a published run id; its exact retained Agent object plus child and parent log boundaries identify that observed activation safely. A ten-second watchdog provides the same reconciliation as a fallback if the live notice event was also missed. Cancellation still rejects the active tool call without consuming records, and parent disposal still releases tracked children and active waits. # dsh-ui-background

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-ui-background.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-ui-background)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/dsh-ui-background.svg)](./LICENSE)
[![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%E2%89%A522.19-339933)](https://nodejs.org)

给 **DeepSeek Harness Web 客户端**加一层本地背景（图片 / 视频）+ 全界面毛玻璃。

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-ui-background
```

> 装完**必须重启一次 Host**（DSH 的模块解析表在启动时构建）。
> 状态：`0.8.2`，在 **DSH 0.2.0-rc.2** 上开发与验证。RC 阶段内部契约会变，升级 DSH 后请重新验收。

## 它是什么（以及为什么不卡）

毛玻璃**不靠扫描 DOM**，而是改官方主题令牌：

```js
ctx.theme.overrideTokens('dsh-ui-background', {
  '--dsw-alias-bg-base':         { light: 'rgba(255,255,255,.62)', dark: '…' },
  '--dsw-specific-sidebar-fill': { light: '…', dark: '…' },
  // 另外 3 个抬升面 / 弹层令牌
})
```

DSH 的 `body`、主框架、侧栏本来就用这些令牌画背景，所以：

- 零 DOM 扫描、零 `MutationObserver`、零逐面板 `backdrop-filter`
- 关掉 = 撤销令牌层，界面**立刻回到出厂样式**，无残留
- 背景层是**一个** `position:fixed; z-index:-1` 的图层（图片走纯 CSS，视频走一个 `<video>`）

## 功能

- 背景来源：上传文件 / 本机路径（只读，不复制不移动）
- 视频背景：`mp4` / `webm` 循环播放，切到后台自动暂停
- 构图：`铺满(cover)` / `完整(contain)`、缩放 50–300%、水平/垂直位置，**预览里可直接拖动**
- 壁纸引擎：自动扫 Steam 工坊 `431960`，**只列出可直接播放的**（视频/图片）
- 最近使用：最多 12 条，带缩略图与**构图参数**，一键切回，可单条删除
- 上传文件可单个删除；删到正在用的那张会自动关掉背景
- 全部本地：不联网、不收集数据

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-ui-background
```

**装完必须重启一次 Host**（DSH 的模块解析表在启动时构建，新装的包当次不可导入）。

重启后：设置 → **背景与玻璃**。

## 适合什么场景

- 用本地图片或视频当背景，界面跟着半透明
- 换图之后不用重新调构图：每条历史记录里都存着缩放与位置

做不到的：Wallpaper Engine 的 Scene 渲染。`scene.pkg` 需要它自己的引擎，本插件只读图片和视频文件。
## 已知限制

| 限制 | 原因 |
|---|---|
| Scene 壁纸不能当背景 | `scene.pkg` 是 Wallpaper Engine 私有格式，需要它的引擎渲染；包里没有现成图片 |
| 别拿 WE 预览图凑数 | 实测预览图只有 **144–254 px**，铺满 1920 宽会糊 7–13 倍 |
| 想要 WE 画面 → 截图 | 开着 WE，`Win+Shift+S` 截屏后点「粘贴截图」（1920×1080，清晰） |
| `mkv` / `mov` 可能不播 | Edge 不支持这些容器，用 `mp4` / `webm` |
| 半透明会影响所有用基础背景令牌的地方 | 代码块顶栏、图片占位、弹层遮罩都会跟着透明，这是同一套令牌的代价 |

## 安全

- Host 端只读**你在设置里显式填写的**那一个本机文件，以及 Steam 工坊目录里的 `project.json` / 媒体 / 预览图
- HTTP 路由仅回环；写操作拒绝 `sec-fetch-site: cross-site`
- 上传目录内的文件名已净化，不接受路径穿越
- 状态存在 `$DSH_HOME/storages/dsh-ui-background/`（`state.json` + `backgrounds/`），卸载插件**不会**自动删除，请自行清理

## 开发

```bash
node selftest.mjs   # 用假 Cordis 上下文挂载 host 半身，直接打自己的 HTTP 处理器
```

`lib` 端只依赖 `node:fs` / `node:path` / `node:os`，没有 npm 运行时依赖。

## License

MIT

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-approval-latency

把「这次工具调用在等人类点审批」这件事**回传给模型**：

> 一次调用卡在审批上等了 6 分 42 秒才被放行时，模型在下一轮会收到一条上下文消息，
> 说明那段空档是**人的响应延迟**，不是工具报错、不是超时、也不是它上一轮的代码有问题——
> 因此不必因为「时间过了很久」去重新排查已经正确的东西。

[English](README.en.md) · MIT · 纯 host 侧，无网络、无文件访问、不改任何审批结果 ·
仓库 <https://github.com/UPxianyu/dsh-approval-latency>

---

## 1. 它解决什么问题

DSH 的运行时上下文里有一行：

```markdown
Elapsed since the preceding model-visible message: 6m 42s
```

（来自 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-time-context`。）它算的是**墙上时间**，但模型看到的只有两个数字：
「上一条消息」和「现在」。审批是唯一会让这个数字突然变大的日常路径——你去开会、去倒水、
去回别人消息，回来才点了「允许一次」。

于是模型面对的是这样的推理岔路：

| 模型看到的 | 常见的错误结论 |
|---|---|
| 工具结果正常返回，但中间空了 7 分钟 | 「刚才那条命令是不是卡住了 / 环境不稳定」 |
| 工具被拒绝，而拒绝出现在 9 分钟后 | 「我的改法不对，用户否掉了，我重写一版」 |
| 两个文件都改完，但两步之间各空了几分钟 | 「前面那些改动可能没生效，重新验证一遍」 |

这三条都会烧掉注意力，而且都建立在**一个并不存在的因果**上：时间 ≠ 结果。
审批的等待时间属于「人」这一侧，跟工具、代码、参数、沙箱都没有关系。

本插件把那句话补上：等待超过阈值时，在**该步骤的工具结果之后**追加一条上下文消息，
明确说清「这段空档是审批等待」。模型不需要猜，也不需要再从时间戳反推。

## 2. 行为

「太长」不是常量，是**先量出来的**：门槛默认由本机最近回答过的审批耗时决定（见第 4 节）。
下表的「门槛」指生效的那个数，不是写死的 30 秒。

| 情形 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| 调用需要审批，等待 ≥ **通过门槛**，最终**通过** | 追加一条提示：等了多久、是人的响应时间、不要因此重开前面的工作 |
| 等待 ≥ **拒绝门槛**（默认是通过门槛的一半），最终**被拒绝** | 追加一条提示：等了多久、这么久之后的「否」可能是过期/误触，若与用户要求不符应先问再改 |
| 等待 ≥ 通过门槛，最终**取消 / 无人应答** | 追加一条提示：这一枪没打响，空档不代表调用或代码有问题 |
| 等待 < 对应门槛 | 什么都不加（正常人点审批的速度不该产生噪音） |
| 该调用**没有**经过审批 | 什么都不加 |
| `reportDenials: false` | 只回报「通过」的等待，拒绝/取消的不回报 |

提示不会改写工具结果本身（审计里 `tool/result` 仍是工具自己的输出），而是作为一条
`notice` 形式的用户消息，紧随本步骤的工具结果进入下一轮请求。

### 2.1 适用场景

**值得开的四种情形**

1. **你离开电脑，审批挂了很久**（本插件实测过 **9 分 8 秒**）。模型拿到的是「工具结果 + 这段是人在点审批」，
   而不是一个来历不明、还特别慢的结果。
2. **长跑 / 无人值守的 Agent**：你在别的窗口干活，审批弹出来半天才看见。
3. **耗时的那次结果又不理想**：没有时间归因时，模型很容易把「久」和「错」连起来，开始怀疑自己前面做过的事。
4. **你确实会拒绝的场合**：拒绝几乎总是发生在你回来之后，模型很容易理解成「我的方案被否了」，
   而实际可能只是回答一个已经过期的提示。

**不需要它的情形**

1. **你总是秒批**：本机实测审批中位数 **4.6 秒**，默认档几乎不会触发（见 2.2 的统计）。
2. **没有审批的操作**（读文件、写工作区内文件）——完全不触发。
3. **想解释「非审批」造成的耗时**（你打断后去处理别的事、机器休眠、模型排队、网络慢）——不在语义内。
4. **`never` 策略**（审批被确定性拒绝）——没有等待，也就没有通知。

### 2.2 一次真实的 9 分 8 秒（实测记录）

2026-10-18 的实测：把一次 `pwsh` 调用挂起 **9 分 8 秒**后才批准。模型在这一步实际收到的两条信息：

```text
[tool/result]  marker read back: Synthetic approval test at 2026-10-18T14:30:34+08:00
               directory removed again: True

[user/message, source.kind = approval-latency]
Approval wait: "pwsh" ran 9m 8s after the user approved it — human latency, not a tool failure,
and not evidence about earlier work. Judge only this result.
```

**同一时刻**，运行时上下文里的耗时行是这个：

```text
Elapsed since the preceding step context: unavailable.
```

也就是：**没有这条通知，模型完全不知道中间过了 9 分钟。** 这不是个例——从本机 6 个会话日志、
32 次审批里统计，工具步骤之后（step ≥ 2）的 elapsed **全部是 `unavailable`**，
带数字的只出现在两条用户消息之间。所以在这台机器上，这条通知是**唯一的时间归因来源**，
成本 156 字符 ≈ **41 token**。

它也确实进了会话日志，能回放：

```text
seq 3217  user/message  source = {"kind":"approval-latency","form":"notice",
                                  "summary":"approval wait 9m 8s before pwsh ran"}
```

另一类更早的真实事故没有日志可查：跑 ComfyUI 出图时模型思考跑偏，只能强行终止。
当时既没有时间线索、也没有「这个否可能是过期的」语义，模型只能自己编原因——这正是本插件要堵的洞。

### 2.3 模型实际读到的文本（三种变体）

每条都是**一行、三件事**：等了多久 → 这是人的延迟而不是失败/代码问题 → 只判这次结果。
解释性从句全部砍掉：一段「关于时间的说明」本身就在邀请模型讨论时间，而这正是要避免的跑偏，还白付一倍 token。

通过（154 字符 ≈ **41 token**）：

```markdown
Approval wait: "bash" ran 2m 8s after the user approved it — human latency, not a tool failure,
and not evidence about earlier work. Judge only this result.
```

拒绝（154 字符 ≈ 41 token；注意这里没有「先去问用户」，只陈述事实）：

```markdown
Approval wait: the user rejected "write" after 4m 10s. A "no" that late may be stale rather than
a verdict on your approach — check it against what was asked.
```

取消 / 无人应答（127 / 116 字符 ≈ 33 / 31 token）：

```markdown
Approval wait: "pwsh" stayed unapproved for 1m 0s and was cancelled, so it never ran.
Human latency, not evidence about the code.
```

> 长度预算是硬约束：`test/latency.test.mjs` 断言四种变体分别不超过 200 / 200 / 170 / 170 字符，
> 且不超过 3 句、必须以 `Approval wait: ` 开头——防止以后越写越长。
answer, so the call never ran. That gap is human or scheduling latency — not evidence about
the call or the code it touches.
```

## 3. 安装

在 DSH 里（profile 名换成你自己的，桌面版默认 `desktop`）：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add /path/to/dsh-approval-latency
```

或从仓库：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:UPxianyu/dsh-approval-latency
```

装完重启 `dsh web`（或桌面版），插件随 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 插入
`approval-latency` 这一行即可生效。

卸载：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-approval-latency
```

### 3.1 在插件页里改（推荐）

插件管理**不在设置对话框里**，它是主界面左侧「全局面板图标」里的一个面板（图标是风车，tooltip「插件」；
设置里的「内置插件」是只读清单）。路径：

**左侧风车图标「插件」→「已安装」→ `dsh-approval-latency` 卡片 → 点带 `›` 的那一行标题
（显示为 `审批等待回传（Approval Wait Notice） ›`，它的无障碍名就是「配置 审批等待回传（Approval Wait Notice）」）**

那一行标题之所以是可点的按钮（带 `›`），正是因为本插件为这一行注册了配置页；
没有注册页的行只是纯文本、没有箭头。

| 控件 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| **自适应** 开关 | 开（默认）：门槛跟着你回答审批的速度走（见 4.2）。关：用下面的固定时长。 |
| **固定时长** 输入框 | 秒数，默认 **30**。回车或失焦才写入；填 0 / 非数字会被拦下并提示，不会写进配置。 |
| **恢复默认** | 清掉本页写入的覆盖，回落到本 bundle 的默认值（30 秒 / 自适应）。 |

写进去的值由 Host 落到 profile 的 Cordis patch（与手改 YAML 同一层），**不需要重启**：
这些字段是 `volatile` 的，改完从下一次审批开始生效。页面上的「已覆盖」徽标表示这一项有页面写入。

页面上看不到「当前学到的基线是多少」——那是宿主内存里的数，只写进 debug 日志；
页面只负责改配置（延迟、体积、侵入性都最小的那一半）。

## 4. 阈值怎么配

这一节是同一份配置的 **YAML 写法**（适合脚本化、团队统一、CI）。两种模式都能在设置页里切换（见 3.1），
定义与算法完全相同。

改配置就在 **profile** 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里用同 id 覆盖（同 id 覆盖会**整块替换**
`config`，所以只写你要改的字段，其余回落到默认值）：

| 你写的 | 生效 |
|---|---|
| 什么都不写 | `mode: auto`（自适应） |
| `mode: auto` | 自适应，用本机速度；`fixedMs` 不参与 |
| `mode: fixed` | 固定 `fixedMs`，默认 **30000（30 秒）** |
| 只写 `fixedMs: 45000` | 自动当成 `mode: fixed`（填了数，数字就该生效） |
| 只写 `thresholdMs: 45000`（0.2.0 的旧写法） | 同上，按别名处理，仍然可用 |

`mode` 显式写了就听它的：`mode: auto` 同时给 `fixedMs` 不算冲突，只是那个数用不上
（和 `mode: fixed` 下 `floorMs` 用不上是一个道理）。

### 4.1 固定时长（最省事的两种写法）

```yaml
# profile/cordis.patch.yml
- id: approval-latency
  name: dsh-approval-latency
  config:
    mode: fixed          # 不写 fixedMs 就用默认 30000 = 30 秒
```

```yaml
- id: approval-latency
  name: dsh-approval-latency
  config:
    mode: fixed
    fixedMs: 45000       # 45 秒
```

**默认为什么是 30 秒**：低于 30 秒基本还是正常点击速度，提醒只会变成噪音；到 30 秒以上，
模型那行 `Elapsed since the preceding model-visible message` 已经大到足以让它怀疑自己，
这时一条「这是审批延迟」最值钱。宁可少提醒，也别让提醒变成背景音。

### 4.2 自适应（默认）怎么算

```
通过门槛 = clamp( multiplier × median(最近 20 次真实回答的耗时), floorMs, ceilingMs )
```

- **样本**：只收「真的回答了」的审批——`allowed-once` 与 `rejected`。取消、无人应答不算，
  因为它们不代表你回答得慢。
- **每条样本先夹到 `ceilingMs`**：一次出门三小时不会把基线拽走。
- **用中位数而不是均值**：偶发的长等待不会移动它。
- **样本不足 `minSamples`（默认 3）时用 30 秒冷启动值**——`30s` 只是「还没有数据时」的占位，
  不是永恒的门槛。
- **正在被判断的这次等待不进样本**：先用历史算门槛、再记账，所以一次超长等待不能自己给自己发通行证。
- `floorMs`（默认 10s）保证再灵敏也不会为「点得挺快」打扰；`ceilingMs`（默认 5min）
  保证基线不会漂到永远不触发。

举例：你平时 4 秒点掉审批 → 门槛 12 秒；某天你一直 90 秒才点 → 门槛自动抬到 5 分钟（上限）。
换台机器、换个人，就是另一套数——因为这个数字本来就该是「对谁而言」。

### 4.3 按结果分流（两种模式都生效）

```
拒绝门槛 = clamp( 通过门槛 × rejectionScale, min(floorMs, 通过门槛), 通过门槛 )
```

迟到的「否」是最贵的误解（模型会去重写代码），所以默认用一半的门槛先提醒一次；
设 `rejectionScale: 1` 就与通过同门槛。取消 / 无人应答仍用通过门槛，因为那本来就不是一次判断。

### 4.4 开关

`reportDenials: false` 只回传通过的等待。

### 4.5 全部字段

本 bundle 的 patch 已写入全部默认值：

```yaml
- id: approval-latency
  name: dsh-approval-latency
  config:
    mode: auto             # auto = 自适应；fixed = 固定 fixedMs
    fixedMs: 30000         # fixed 模式的固定时长（毫秒）；不写 mode 时填了它即按 fixed
    floorMs: 10000         # auto：门槛下限
    ceilingMs: 300000      # auto：门槛上限，也是单条样本的截断值
    multiplier: 3          # auto：几倍本机中位数算「异常长」
    minSamples: 3          # auto：攒够几条真实回答才从冷启动切到学习值
    rejectionScale: 0.5    # 拒绝门槛 = 通过门槛 × 该系数，范围 (0, 1]
    reportDenials: true    # 是否也回传拒绝 / 取消 / 无人应答
```

| 字段 | 默认值 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|
| `mode` | `auto` | `auto` 学习本机速度；`fixed` 永远用 `fixedMs`。 |
| `fixedMs` | `30000` | 固定模式的门槛（毫秒）。`0` 表示每次审批都回传（调试用）。 |
| `floorMs` | `10000` | 自适应门槛下限：低于它的等待永不打扰。 |
| `ceilingMs` | `300000` | 自适应门槛上限，同时截断单条样本。 |
| `multiplier` | `3` | 「异常长」= 多少倍本机中位数。越小越敏感。 |
| `minSamples` | `3` | 攒够多少条真实回答才从冷启动切到学习值。 |

plugins.description: DSH 插件：Skill 与 MCP 使用审计。扫描 20 类 skill 来源，标注每个 skill 来自哪个工具，在对话顶部状态栏显示真实调用次数、成败、耗时与 MCP 使用。
plugins.readme_text:
# skill-use — Skill 与 MCP 使用审计

[![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-plugin-3ecf8e)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue)](LICENSE)
[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@yizitiguan/skill-use)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@yizitiguan/skill-use)

DSH 插件。回答三个原生 UI 回答不了的问题：

1. **我到底装了多少 skill？它们来自哪个工具？**
2. **这次任务真正调用了哪些 skill，成功还是失败？**
3. **MCP 有哪些 server / 工具，被调用了多少次？**

入口在**对话顶部状态栏**（与子智能体、团队看板、任务列表同一排），
点击展开面板。

---

## 安装

要求 DSH `>= 0.1.5-rc.1`。本插件**无构建步骤**，纯 ESM + 浏览器端纯 JS，
克隆下来即可用。

### 方式一：npm（最快）

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> add @yizitiguan/skill-use
```

### 方式二：从 GitHub 本地链接

克隆后用 `link:` 方式装进 profile：

```bash
git clone https://github.com/yizitiguan/skill-use.git
dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> add link:<克隆下来的绝对路径>
```

或者在 DSH 里用插件管理器：

```
plugin_manager install_bundle <克隆下来的 skill-use 目录绝对路径>
```

### 方式三：手动写进 profile

```yaml
# ~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml
- insert:
    - id: skill-use
      name: '@yizitiguan/skill-use'
```

同时确保包已在 profile 的 `node_modules` 里（`pnpm add link:<目录>` 或从 npm 装）。

安装完成后**刷新页面**，顶部状态栏会出现 `Skill · 已用/已发现` 按钮。

> ⚠ 开发注意：`lib/client.js` 里 `__ModuleLoader__.load({ id })` 的 `id`
> **必须等于 package.json 的包名**。装载器按包名分配模块 id，不一致会导致
> factory 注册不上 —— 表现为插槽 `active: true` 但界面完全不渲染。
> 插槽注册用的 `id: 'skill-use'` 是另一个东西（cell key），不受此约束。

---

## 面板内容

```
┌─ Skill 使用 ─────────────────────────────── ✕ ┐
│ SKILL 使用                      1 次 · 1 个   │
│  ● cordis-plugin-development  [内置]  ×1 成功  │
│                          ▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓  4ms        │
├───────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ 来源分布                      1 个来源         │
│  ● Agent  [DSH 加载]  45 个 · 已用 0  ▓▓▓▓▓▓  │
├───────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ MCP 使用                                       │
│  当前 profile 未配置 MCP server。配置后会显示    │
│  调用次数、方法与成功率。                        │
├───────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ ▸ 未使用的 Skill 45 · 禁用 1                   │
├───────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ 发现 45 个  已用 1 个  调用 1 次                │
└───────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

| 区块 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| Skill 使用 | 每个被调用 skill 的次数、成败、平均耗时、来源标签 |
| 来源分布 | 按工具来源统计数量与使用情况，标出 DSH 会加载的来源 |
| **MCP 使用** | MCP server 调用次数、方法明细、已注册 MCP 工具 |
| 未使用的 Skill | 可折叠；标出被 skills-manager 禁用的项 |
| 统计窗口 | 事件数与时间跨度 |

每个 skill 带**来源标签**：
- `[Claude Code]` / `[Agent]` / … → 磁盘上的来源目录
- `[内置]` → 磁盘上找不到，说明是插件 / preset 自带 skill

---

## MCP 是怎么识别的

DSH 里 MCP 工具**没有统一前缀**，所以分三层识别（`lib/state.js` 的 `classifyMcp`）：

1. **内置资源工具**（精确集合，来自 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-resources`）：
   `list_mcp_resources`、`list_mcp_resource_templates`、`read_mcp_resource`
   —— 参数带 `server` 字段，可精确归因
2. **约定前缀**：`mcp__<server>__<tool>` 或 `mcp_<server>_<tool>`
3. **注册表匹配**：`ctx.tools.schemas()` 里识别出的 MCP 工具名

server 名优先取调用参数里的 `server`，否则取工具名前缀。
调用了但注册表里没有的 server 会进 `stale`，便于排查已卸载的配置。

> ⚠ **本机的实际状态是没有配置任何 MCP server**，所以面板显示
> 「当前 profile 未配置 MCP server」。这是如实反映，不是渲染失败。
> 统计链路（`auditUsage` 的 MCP 分支）已实现，配置 server 后自动生效，
> 但**这条路径未在真实 MCP server 上验证过**。

---

## 为什么要扫盘

DSH 原生 `ctx.skills.list()` 只报当前 session 可见的 skill —— 本机上只有 **8 个**。

而用户实际安装了 **45 个**，全在 `~/.agents/skills/` 里。
各家 AI 编码工具（Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Qoder、Trae、Lingma…）
都把 skills 放在自己的配置目录下，格式统一为：

```
<tool-home>/skills/<skill-name>/SKILL.md   ← 带 YAML frontmatter
```

所以本插件**直接扫盘**，而不是依赖原生服务。

### 支持的来源（20 类）

与 [`@michengai/dsh-skills-manager`](https://github.com/MichengAI/dsh-skills-manager)
的 `EXTERNAL_SOURCE_ORDER` 对齐：

| 来源 | 路径 | DSH 加载 |
|---|---|---|
| DSH | `~/.dsh/skills` | ✅ |
| Agent | `~/.agents/skills` | ✅ |
| Codex | `~/.codex/skills` | |
| Claude Code | `~/.claude/skills` | |
| Gemini | `~/.gemini/skills` | |
| OpenCode | `~/.config/opencode/skills` | |
| Cursor | `~/.cursor/skills` | |
| Copilot | `~/.copilot/skills` | |
| Windsurf | `~/.codeium/windsurf/skills` | |
| Windsurf (user) | `~/.windsurf/skills` | |
| Trae / Trae CN | `~/.trae/skills`、`~/.trae-cn/skills` | |
| OpenClaw | `~/.openclaw/skills` | |
| ClawdBot | `~/.clawdbot/skills` | |
| Roo | `~/.roo/skills` | |
| CodeBuddy | `~/.codebuddy/skills` | |
| WorkBuddy | `~/.workbuddy/skills` | |
| Qoder / Qoder CN | `~/.qoder/skills`、`~/.qoder-cn/skills` | |
| Lingma | `~/.lingma/skills` | |

每类都支持环境变量覆盖（如 `DSH_CLAUDE_HOME`），与 skills-manager 约定一致。

---

## 数据怎么来的

### 调用统计

```
tool/call    name=skill  args={"name":"cordis-plugin-development"}
tool/result  message.toolCallId → 配对回该次调用，读 error / isError
```

- 调用次数、成功 / 失败、本轮平均耗时
- 失败时记录 `error.reason`
- 用 `tool/call` 的参数名去来源索引里查，得到**来源归因**

### 来源归因

1. 扫盘得到 `name → { source, sourceLabel }` 索引
2. 同名 skill 出现在多个来源时，优先取 `native`（DSH 实际会加载的那个）
3. 查不到 → 标记为 `builtin`（插件 / preset 内置）

---

## 主题与美化

面板只使用 `--dsw-*` 令牌上色。这是 DSH 给插件作者的规范，
也是 [dsh-wallpaper-engine](https://github.com/elysia395/dsh-wallpaper-engine)
**自动把玻璃质感传给第三方插件**的机制：

> 它自己的 `docs/COEXISTENCE.md` 写明：「按宿主规范上色的第三方插件会**继承**我们的玻璃 ——
> DSH 给插件作者的规范是用 `--dsw-alias-*` 设计令牌上色，而这些令牌在玻璃生效时
> 被改写成玻璃配方 ⇒ 任何按规范写的插件都会自动带上玻璃质感。」

所以正确做法是**只消费令牌、不自己造模糊**。用到的令牌：

```
--dsw-alias-bg-base / bg-layer-1 / bg-layer-2 / bg-layer-3 / bg-overlay
--dsw-alias-border-l1 / border-l2
--dsw-alias-label-primary / label-secondary / label-tertiary
--dsw-alias-brand-primary
--dsw-alias-state-success-primary / state-error-primary / state-idle-primary
--dsw-specific-sidebar-fill
```

### 玻璃配方：复刻 wallpaper-engine 的「可读性地板 + 玻璃色」

菜单的底色**不是自己调出来的不透明度**，而是直接搬它的公式
（`src/styles-base.js` 里所有玻璃表面都用这一条）：

```css
color-mix(in srgb,
  var(--we-readability-base) calc(var(--we-readability-floor) * 100%),
  color-mix(in srgb,
    var(--we-surface-tint-light) calc(var(--we-glass-alpha) * 100%),
    transparent))
```

原理是**两层叠加**：

| 层 | 作用 | 取值 |
|---|---|---|
| 地板 `--we-readability-floor` | 不透明底，保证文字任何情况下可读 | 浅色 0.45 / 深色 0.59 |
| 釉色 `--we-glass-alpha` | 按透明度叠一层玻璃色，提供通透感 | 0.10 – 0.25 |

为什么必须有地板：只调 alpha 不够。深色主题下釉色是**白色**，
叠在最亮的壁纸像素上会让白字对比度掉到 1.00:1，彻底看不见。
地板权重固定、任何滑杆都压不低，所以 `有效覆盖 = 地板 + a·(1−地板) ≥ 地板`。

本插件消费这四个变量（`--we-readability-base` / `--we-readability-floor` /
`--we-surface-tint-light|dark` / `--we-glass-alpha`），**存在就用宿主的值**，
不存在就用同公式的兜底值。所以在设置里拉动「玻璃透明度」时，
这个菜单会跟着一起变，而不是各调各的。

### 四个必须避开的坑

**1. 弹层必须 `createPortal` 到 `document.body`。**
官方 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-jobs`（就是「1 个后台任务」那个下拉框）
就是这么做的。header 的祖先链上有 `backdrop-filter`，它会让
`position: fixed` 后代**以它为包含块** —— 弹层被压在 header 尺寸里，
宽度撑不开、内容竖排换行。

**2. 菜单自己加 `backdrop-filter` 是安全的。**
坑 1 说的是**祖先**加模糊会劫持后代的包含块；菜单本身是最外层
`fixed` 元素、没有后代要定位，自己加 blur 不产生这个问题。

**3. 底色不能用 `--dsw-alias-bg-base` 或 `bg-layer-1`。**
- `bg-base` 在壁纸开启时被设成 `transparent`（它要让壁纸透出来）
- `bg-layer-1` 在玻璃配方下是半透明 `color-mix`

它们单独或叠加都挡不住底层文字 —— 这就是「完全透明、字叠字」的成因。

**4. 数值要跟宿主同源，不要自己拍。**
曾经的 `rgba(30,30,36,.94)` 是 94% 不透明，把模糊整个盖死，
观感是**一块死灰板**。仿官方视觉必须仿**配方**，不是仿一个看着像的颜色。

### 令牌名必须真实存在

早期版本用了 `--dsw-alias-bg-elevated`、`--dsw-alias-text-primary` 这类
**不存在的名字**，`var()` 全部落到兜底值 ⇒ 面板不跟随主题。
真实清单见 [`TOKEN-CONTRACT.md`](https://github.com/elysia395/dsh-wallpaper-engine/blob/main/docs/TOKEN-CONTRACT.md)
（自动生成、有守卫对账）。注意 `Theme.listTokens` 只暴露 14 个常用令牌，
而实际契约里共有 **59 个**。

---

## 设置

**设置 → Skill 使用**：

| 项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 刷新间隔 | 1.5 / 2 / 5 / 10 秒 |
| 汇总 / Skill 使用 / 未使用 / 来源分布 / 统计窗口 | 逐区块开关，立即生效 |

也可以改 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`：

```yaml
- id: skill-use
  config:
    refreshMs: 2000
    sections:
      usage: true
      idle: true
      sources: true
```

---

## 接口

| 方法 | 路径 | 用途 |
|---|---|---|
| GET | `/api/skill-use/snapshot?session=<id>` | 审计快照 |
| GET | `/api/skill-use/settings` | 读配置 |
| POST | `/api/skill-use/settings` | 写配置（局部合并） |

---

## 已验证（真实数据）

```json
{
  "skillCalls": 1,
  "skillsUsed": 1,
  "skillsDiscovered": 45,
  "skillsVisible": 8,
  "sourcesWithSkills": 1,
  "builtinUsed": 1,
  "skillsDisabled": 1,
  "managerInstalled": true
}
```

来源分布：`Agent`（`~/.agents/skills`）45 个、`native: true`、禁用 1 个。

使用明细：`cordis-plugin-development` ×1、成功、**内置**。
（DSH 原生服务只看到 8 个，这个不在其中——印证了扫盘的必要性。）

被禁用项：`ask-matt` —— 来自读取 skills-manager 的 `state.json`，
不是猜的。

---

## 与 skills-manager 的分工

读了 [`@michengai/dsh-skills-manager`](https://github.com/MichengAI/dsh-skills-manager)
的源码，它负责**管理**（安装 / 启用 / 禁用 / 分类），状态存在
`~/.dsh/skills-manager/state.j

plugins.description: TypeSafe Jev for DeepSeek Harness, the Model Context Protocol, and plain Node: typed judgments instead of prose, offline by default.
plugins.readme_text:
# jevcore
[![dshfind](https://dshfind.com/api/badge/PerryLink/jevcore?metric=downloads)](https://dshfind.com/plugins/PerryLink/jevcore?ref=badge)

[![DSH Market](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2BingLing/dsh-market/master/assets/readme/badge-listed-en.svg)](https://dsh.market/)
[![OpenSSF Scorecard](https://api.securityscorecards.dev/projects/github.com/PerryLink/jevcore/badge)](https://api.securityscorecards.dev/projects/github.com/PerryLink/jevcore)
[![jevcore MCP server](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/PerryLink/jevcore/badges/score.svg)](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/PerryLink/jevcore)

TypeSafe [Jev](https://typesafe.ai) for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
and any other MCP host.

Jev is not a chat model. It answers typed questions — `noul` (yes/no), `choice`, `score` — and returns
calibrated probabilities. It does not write prose, and asking it to is a category error. This project
gives an agent exactly that surface, and nothing more.

**Offline by default. Egress disclosed. Nothing default-on.**

---

**📖 Ecosystem knowledge base** — measured data, not marketing: [plugin development guide · plugin-selection data · maintenance criteria](https://perrylink.github.io/dsh-plugin-guide/).

<!-- star-cta -->
## ⭐ 如果它帮到了你

这个插件是 [DSH 插件家族](https://github.com/PerryLink)的一员（95 个，全部 Apache-2.0）。如果你在用，**给个 star** —— 它不会解锁任何功能，但会让下一个人在搜索里更容易找到它。

*English:* part of a 95 plugin family for DeepSeek Harness. If it is useful, **a star helps the next person find it** — nothing is gated behind it.


## Three packages, one decision layer

| Package | What it is | Use it when |
|---|---|---|
| [`jevcore`](packages/core) | The decisions. Imports nothing from DeepSeek Harness or Cordis. | You want Jev in a plain script, a service, or your own harness |
| [`jevcore-dsh`](packages/dsh) | The DSH plugin: one service, three tools, two opt-in gates | You are running DeepSeek Harness |
| [`jevcore-mcp`](packages/mcp) | The same three tools over MCP, with a stdio binary | Your host speaks MCP but is not DSH |

The adapters are thin on purpose. `packages/dsh` is four files: it declares tool schemas and
translates hook payloads. Everything decision-shaped — the primitives, the providers, the egress
contract, the policy, the gates — lives in core, so a new adapter cannot drift from the guarantees
the others make.
One runtime requirement differs across the three: `jevcore-dsh` tracks the harness and needs
Node `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`, while `jevcore` and `jevcore-mcp` need `>=20`.

---

## Why this exists

Between 2026-09-17 and 09-20, nineteen plugins appeared that wire Jev into DSH. Auditing their source
found a consistent pattern: the module labelled *guard*, *gate*, or *warden* was also the module
shipping prompts, tool arguments, and file contents to a third party, and the README generally did not
say so. Several were enabled by default. One gate could be reconfigured by the model it was guarding.

This project is the same idea with those failure modes designed out:

| Property | How it is guaranteed here |
|---|---|
| No network call unless you ask for one | Default provider is an offline mock; the live path needs both `provider: live` and a resolved credential |
| Every transmission named before it happens | One startup log line per feature: `off` or `SENDS <feature> { fields }` |
| Gates register nothing when disabled | Verified by test, not by policy — a disabled gate adds no event listener at all |
| The model cannot widen its own constraints | No tool exposes gate configuration |
| A judge that cannot answer never means "allow" | Undecided resolves through explicit config, defaulting to `ask` |

---

## The egress contract

This is the part worth reading before installing.

Transmission is decided per feature, and every feature defaults to off. The plugin prints its own
contract at load:

```
[jevcore] provider=mock  endpoint=none  egress=OFF  (no network calls will be made; every answer is synthetic)
[jevcore] ready - provider=mock - gates: safety=off context=off
```

With `provider: live` and every feature enabled, the same report becomes explicit about what leaves:

```
[jevcore] provider=live  endpoint=https://api.typesafe.ai  egress=ON
[jevcore]   SENDS  tool:jev_ask  { state<=16000c questions<=4000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  tool:jev_rank  { state<=16000c questions<=4000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  tool:jev_check  { state<=16000c questions<=4000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  gate:safety  { state<=8000c questions<=2000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  gate:context  { state<=6000c questions<=2000c }
[jevcore]   redaction is best-effort; it removes named fields and known secret shapes, and cannot
             recognise an unrecognised secret in free text
```

| Feature | Off by default? | What it sends |
|---|---|---|
| `tool:jev_ask` | runs when the model calls it | the arguments the model passed, after redaction |
| `tool:jev_rank` | runs when the model calls it | the query plus every candidate |
| `tool:jev_check` | runs when the model calls it | the claim and its evidence |
| `gate:safety` | **yes — explicit opt-in** | the tool name, its arguments, the workspace root |
| `gate:context` | **yes — explicit opt-in** | a large tool result the agent just received |

The tools transmit only when the model chooses to call them, which is visible in the transcript. The
gates would run on every matching tool call, which is not, so they are opt-in.

### Redaction, and its honest limit

Before anything is sent, `src/redact.ts` runs two passes: values under sensitive field names
(`password`, `token`, `apiKey`, `authorization`, …) are replaced wholesale, and secret-shaped strings
that survive into free text are pattern-matched (`Bearer …`, `sk-…`, `ts_live_…`, AWS/GitHub/Google
key shapes, JWTs, private-key headers, credentials in connection strings).

This is a mitigation, not a permission. A secret that sits under an unrecognised key name *and* does
not match a known shape will pass through. If that possibility is unacceptable for your workload, do
not enable the live provider.

---

## Install

### As a DeepSeek Harness plugin

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add jevcore-dsh
```

Or from a checkout:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add /absolute/path/to/jevcore/packages/dsh
```

`packages/dsh` imports `jevcore` by name, so a checkout also needs core
resolvable from the profile (`add /absolute/path/to/jevcore/packages/core`).

Then confirm the row activated — the plugin list should show `jev` as `active`,
not `failed` — and check the startup report in the log.

### As an MCP server

For a host that speaks MCP, the same three tools are available over stdio:

```sh
npx -y jevcore-mcp
```

To wire it into DeepSeek Harness specifically, install a configuration-only bundle
whose patch inserts the harness's own MCP client:

```yml
- insert:
    - id: jev-mcp
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
      config:
        serverName: jev
        transport: stdio
        command: npx
        args: ['-y', 'jevcore-mcp']
        env:
          TYPESAFE_API_KEY: '<the key>'
        failOnStartupError: true
```

The env map is not optional: DSH strips every credential-shaped name — anything
containing KEY, PASSWORD, SECRET or TOKEN, in any case — from the environment it
hands a spawned server, then merges this map back in afterwards. A key exported in
your shell never arrives, and the server stays on the offline mock without
reporting an error.

The provider is chosen from the environment:

| Variable | Effect |
|---|---|
| `TYPESAFE_API_KEY` | Selects the TypeSafe route when present |
| `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` | Selects the OpenRouter route when present and no TypeSafe key is set |
| `JEV_PROVIDER` | `mock`, `live`, or `openrouter` — overrides the heuristic above |
| `TYPESAFE_MODEL` / `OPENROUTER_MODEL` | Model id for the selected route |
| `TYPESAFE_BASE_URL` / `OPENROUTER_BASE_URL` | API root for the selected route |

With neither key it stays on the offline mock. Unlike the plugin, the MCP server
resolves its credential once at startup, so a missing key with
`JEV_PROVIDER=live` is a startup error rather than a per-call surprise.

plugins.description: Git worktree panel for DeepSeek Harness: branch/merge topology, worktrees, changes and file tree.
plugins.readme_text:
在一个侧栏里读完 Git 的分支、工作树和改动。
只读查看：不 checkout、不切目录、不提交。

## 面板

- **顶部 · 当前工作树**：路径、分支（detached 时显示 `detached @ `）、`↑ahead ↓behind`、`clean / dirty / conflict`，以及 `本地分支 · 远程分支 · Worktree` 计数。 - **中部 · 分支拓扑**：主干永远是一条直线，分支向右生长，合并收回主干；点一条线高亮整条路径。 - **底部 · 详情与列表**：点提交 / 分支 / 工作树看详情；其余工作树、CHANGES、FILES 都在这里，文件行可直接点开预览。 ## 安装（DSH） ### 从插件市场（推荐） 打开 **插件 → 实验性插件 → 更多 → 自定义插件市场**，添加索引源： ```text https://leonz666.github.io/dsh-gitworktree-gui/market/index.json ``` 然后在 **发现** 里搜索「Git 工作树面板」点安装。 ### 从 npm 安装 插件已发布到 npm：`dsh-gitworktree-gui`。终端里用 DSH CLI 装进指定 profile（需要本机有 `dsh` 与 `pnpm`，命令会把参数转发给 profile 目录里的 pnpm，从 npm 解析包）： ```sh npm view dsh-gitworktree-gui version # 查看最新版本，可选 dsh plugin --profile add dsh-gitworktree-gui dsh plugin --profile add dsh-gitworktree-gui@<版本> # 固定版本 ``` 桌面端 profile 由 Electron 管理，请用下面的插件页 / `plugin_manager`；CLI 的插件管理请求不作用于它。 ### 在 DSH 里直接安装 在插件页或 `plugin_manager` 工具里： ```text plugin_manager action=install_bundle target=dsh-gitworktree-gui ``` `target` 也可以是下面几种形式： - `git+https://github.com/LeonZ666/dsh-gitworktree-gui.git` — 直接装当前 `main`（不要用 `github:` 简写，匿名用户会走 SSH） - `/绝对路径/dsh-gitworktree-gui-<版本>.tgz` — 离线包，仓库根执行 `npm pack` 得到 - `/绝对路径/dsh-gitworktree-gui` — 本地源码，`link:` 安装，改代码即时生效 `engines.dsh` 要求 `>=0.2.1-rc.2`，不满足时安装会被拒绝并回滚。装好后刷新 Web 页面；改过宿主入口 `index.js` / `lib/` 需要重开 DSH。
更新与卸载 用新 spec 再执行一次 `install_bundle`；同名包已安装时先卸载再装。 ```text plugin_manager action=set_bundle target=dsh-gitworktree-gui enabled=false plugin_manager action=remove_bundle target=dsh-gitworktree-gui ```
## 使用 1. 点会话头部右上角的 Git 图标，面板作为右栏标签打开。 2. 默认读取当前会话目录；顶部条始终显示正在查看的 worktree 的路径、分支与状态。 3. 在 WORKTREES 里点其他工作树，只切换「看哪棵树」，不执行 checkout，也不改变聊天的工作目录；「返回会话工作区」回到默认目录。 4. 点提交看完整消息、改动文件和 diff；点分支线段选路径；点工作树看 HEAD、上游和 dirty 文件数。 5. CHANGES / FILES 里的文件行点开，会在侧边栏新开一个 tab 显示文件内容；关闭 Git 面板标签页即停止轮询。 6. 目录还没 `git init` 时，面板会给出提示；初始化后点「已初始化，重新读取」。插件不会替你初始化或修改仓库。

点开提交：完整消息、改动文件与单文件 diff 在同一栏展开。

## 只读与边界 只读：不提交、不切分支、不合并、不删除工作树、不初始化仓库。Git 用固定参数的 `execFile`，不拼 shell；DSH 路由只接受 loopback，显式路径受 `allowedRoots` 限制。采集上限为 120 个提交 / 700 个文件（提交详情 300 个文件，单文件 diff 128 KiB / 1200 行），读取失败会保留旧快照并标记过期，而不是显示成干净。 ## License [MIT](LICENSE) · 开发：`npm ci && npm run verify` · 发布见 [RELEASING.md](RELEASING.md) 在 Codex 和 Claude 上也能安装，适配入口见 [`codex/`](codex/) 与 [`hooks/`](hooks/)。

plugins.description: Native Rapid-MLX provider for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — dsh reads model facts from the server instead of your settings.yaml.
plugins.readme_text:
# @raullenchai/dsh-provider

A native [Rapid-MLX](https://github.com/raullenchai/Rapid-MLX) provider for
[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) — so `dsh`
gets its model facts from the server instead of from whatever you typed into
`settings.yaml`.

[![CI](https://github.com/raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

> **Status: published to npm** as
> [`@raullenchai/dsh-provider`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@raullenchai/dsh-provider).
> The end-to-end `dsh` run in [Verified](#verified) was on an M3 Ultra against
> `dsh 0.1.0-rc.7`; `dsh 0.1.0-rc.8` is API-compatible — the `LlmAdapter`
> contract is byte-identical and the only changes are additive — and the
> adapter is re-verified against rc.8 at the protocol and unit-test level.
> DSH is still a developer preview that moves fast, so treat this as tracking
> a moving target, not a frozen compatibility promise.

## What it does for you

DSH can already talk to a local Rapid-MLX server through its generic
`openai-completions` provider. That route works — but it knows nothing about
your model beyond what you hand-wrote:

```yaml
# what the generic route makes you maintain, by hand, per model
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    rapid-mlx:
      baseURL: http://localhost:8000/v1
      defaultContextWindow: 262144      # you looked this up. is it still right?
      models:
        - id: qwen3.6-35b-8bit
          contextWindow: 262144
          reasoningEfforts: {off: none, low: low, medium: medium, high: high}
```

Rapid-MLX's `/v1/models` already publishes all of that and more. This adapter
reads it, so:

**1. Nothing to hand-write, and nothing to re-write when you switch models.**
Swap what `rapid-mlx serve` is running and `dsh` follows. No re-running setup,
no stale numbers.

**2. The reasoning control tells the truth.** Rapid-MLX reports whether a model
actually has a reasoning parser. A model that can't reason no longer shows an
off/low/medium/high selector that does nothing.

**3. Compaction is timed with the capacity that actually fits this Mac, not a
number that drifted.** This is the one that quietly costs you.
`dsh-compaction-basic` asks the provider for the route's capacity and compacts
at `thresholdRatio × capacity` (0.8 by default). The provider prefers the
server's **`max_model_len`** — Rapid-MLX's memory-fitted ceiling (what fits in
unified memory: weights + KV cache), in the vLLM/SGLang-standard field — over
the native `context_window`, and falls back to `context_window` on an older
server that doesn't report it. So compaction is timed to what the machine can
actually hold, not the model's advertised window (which it may not have room
for) and not a hand-written number copied from another model.

## Install

Needs Node ≥ 22.15 (dsh imports Node's Zstd stream API without declaring it)
and a running Rapid-MLX server.

```sh
# From npm:
dsh plugin --profile web add @raullenchai/dsh-provider

# …or straight from source — the package ships plain JS with no build step:
dsh plugin --profile web add github:raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider

export RAPID_MLX_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8000/v1     # optional; this is the default
dsh web
```

Then point the agent at the route:

```yaml
# $DSH_HOME/settings.yaml
agent-default-model:
  provider: rapid-mlx
  model: qwen3.6-35b-8bit
```

Verified: that command installs and activates as a profile layer against
`dsh 0.1.0-rc.7`. To hack on it locally instead, see
[Local development](#local-development).

## Model management (v0.2.0)

Beyond the provider route, the plugin registers five tools and a `/rapid-mlx`
command so the agent can see and manage models without leaving the session.
The split follows which surface actually owns each fact: served-model facts
come from the structured HTTP `/v1/models`; the download cache and pull/remove
are CLI-only, so those — and only those — shell out to `rapid-mlx` through the
harness subprocess seam.

| Tool | Source | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `rapid_mlx_serving` | HTTP `/v1/models` | The model(s) served right now, deduped, with context window, reasoning/tool parsers, MoE/hybrid, and modalities. |
| `rapid_mlx_cached` | `rapid-mlx models --cached` | Downloaded models and their on-disk size. |
| `rapid_mlx_pull` | `rapid-mlx pull <name>` | Download a model (alias or HF repo id). Cancellable; no fixed deadline. |
| `rapid_mlx_remove` | `rapid-mlx rm -y <name>` | Delete a cached model to free disk. |
| `rapid_mlx_health` | HTTP + `rapid-mlx --version` | API up? CLI reachable? Reported as two independent facts. |

`/rapid-mlx` prints a one-shot overview: health, the served model and its facts,
and total cache disk usage.

The CLI is resolved from the `cliCommand` config (default `rapid-mlx` on
`PATH`, or `$RAPID_MLX_CLI`); set it to an absolute path if the binary is not on
the harness's `PATH`. `rapid_mlx_pull`/`rapid_mlx_remove` are the only tools
that change anything on disk, and they run non-interactively (`rm` is forced
with `-y` because the subprocess seam ignores stdin).

## Verified

Against `dsh 0.1.0-rc.7` on an M3 Ultra:

- Installs and **activates as a profile layer** (no "declares no `dsh.bundle`"
  warning; the entry shows up in `dsh --profile headless --dump-config`).
- Registers the `rapid-mlx` route with `ctx.llm` and serves real queries.
- Plain chat, a single tool call, and the multi-step bug-fix task that gates
  Rapid-MLX releases — the last one fixed the bug and made the target repo's own
  test pass, verified independently, in 36 s on `qwen3.6-35b-8bit`.

## Not done yet

Being explicit, because the point of the adapter is to *use* what the server
says and some of it is still only read:

- `recommended_sampling` — should be applied automatically per model.
- `tool_call_parser` — should let `dsh` fail fast on a model that cannot emit
  `tool_calls`, instead of looping.
- `is_hybrid` / `is_moe` / `capabilities` — read, not yet acted on.
- **Memory-aware capacity.** Today `resolveModel()` reports the model's
  *advertised* context window. On a Mac the real ceiling is unified memory, and
  reporting that instead is the biggest remaining win — it needs Rapid-MLX to
  expose a usable-capacity figure first.
- Images are not carried through `stream()` — but they now **refuse** with
  `LlmError(..., 'UNSUPPORTED')` rather than being dropped, per the cookbook.
  Text, reasoning and tool calls are carried.
- The route is registered as `rapid-mlx`. If your `settings.yaml` also declares
  a `rapid-mlx` provider under `llm-pi-ai`, the two compete for one route name
  (`registerAdapter` owns provider exclusivity). Use one or rename ours.

## Conformance with the official adapter contract

Built against
[`docs/cookbook/adding-an-llm-adapter.md`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/main/docs/cookbook/adding-an-llm-adapter.md)
and its "protocol obligations" section. Each item has a test:

| Obligation | How it is met |
|---|---|
| `usage` before `finish`, nothing after `finish` | usage is buffered and flushed at end-of-stream, so a trailing usage-only chunk cannot reorder it |
| Tool-call `arguments` are raw JSON strings end to end | fragments stream as `argumentsDelta` and reassemble unparsed |
| Block indexes in first-seen order, reused per block | verified across a reasoning-then-text response |
| Errors take exactly two sanctioned paths | transport/protocol failures **throw** `LlmError` with a stable code; nothing ends the stream quietly |
| Honor `options.signal` | passed to `fetch` and to the SSE reader; an `AbortError` is re-thrown unchanged, not reclassified |
| A field the provider cannot honor throws `UNSUPPORTED` | image content refuses instead of being narrowed away |
| Config is a schemastery schema with env fallback | `export const Config`, fed from `cordis.patch.yml` via `!!js process.env.RAPID_MLX_BASE_URL` |

`finish.replayState` is not emitted: Rapid-MLX needs no native response ids
or signatures on follow-up calls, so there is nothing lossless to project.

## Three things worth knowing before you edit this
