plugins.readme_text:
Skills Hub · 技能中枢

看清每个 Skill 在模型上下文里到底花了多少，并把不需要的从目录里摘掉——文件不删。

## 它解决什么问题 Skill 不是免费的。它对上下文的影响有三层，而 DSH 只把结果给你、不把账单给你： | 层 | 何时付费 | 现象 | | --- | --- | --- | | **目录行** | **每一次请求** | 每个 skill 的 `名称 + 截断后的介绍` 都在系统提示里 | | **目录副本** | 每次目录变更追加一份完整副本 | 改一次 skill，历史里就多一份完整目录，旧的不删 | | **正文** | 模型调用 skill 时加载一次 | 之后永久留在历史里 | Skills Hub 把这三层逐项量化，并给你一个不破坏文件的减负开关。 ## 功能 - **真实目录成本**：按 DSH 的渲染规则逐字计算（`- \`name\`: description`，空白归一化后按 `catalogDescriptionMaxLength` 截断，默认 500 字符）。token 为估算值（CJK ≈ 1.1/字，其余 ≈ 4 字符/token）。 - **模型实际看到的目录**：面板给出两个版本——**本会话已发布**（从会话里真实的 `skill-catalog` 消息取出，与模型收到的那条**逐字一致**）与**下次发布预演**（按当前配置推算，同样逐字对齐 DSH 模板）。 - **目录漂移告警**：当前技能集合与会话已发布的那份不一致时，提示「目录已变更：+ / - / ~，下次请求将追加一份完整副本」。 - **一键减负**：「从目录隐藏」写入 `disable-model-invocation: true`，文件保留、`/名字` 仍可手动调用，但不再进入模型目录，成本立刻归零。 - **分类筛选**：`全部` / `内置` / `第三方`（内置 = 随 DSH、插件或 Agent 预设安装，只读；第三方 = 装在项目或用户目录，可改可删），带数量、可与搜索叠加。 - **为什么模型看不到它**：DSH 对无效 frontmatter 是静默跳过的。面板列出磁盘上存在却没进目录的技能及原因（缺 frontmatter、name 非 kebab-case、布尔值非法、同名被高优先级目录覆盖）。 - **从 URL 导入**：ClawHub `clawhub.ai//`、Skills.sh `skills.sh///`、GitHub `github.com//[/tree//]`，文件由服务端拉取。 - **卸载**：两步确认，仅删除该 skill 的文件，不影响插件本体。


> 本插件不注册任何模型工具或技能，自身对上下文的固定占用为 **0 token**。 ## 安装 ### 从 GitHub 安装（推荐） ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add git+https://github.com/xiatian-wuhan/dsh-skills-hub.git ``` 固定到某个提交（可复现）： ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add "git+https://github.com/xiatian-wuhan/dsh-skills-hub.git#" ``` 安装后重启 `dsh web`，打开 **设置 → Skills Hub**。 ### 通过插件市场索引 本仓库同时是一份 DSH 插件市场索引（format 1）。在 DSH 里 **插件 → Discover → 索引源 → 添加** 以下任一地址： | 用途 | 地址 | | --- | --- | | 主地址（GitHub Pages） | `https://xiatian-wuhan.github.io/dsh-skills-hub/index.json` | | 备用（raw，立即可用） | `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xiatian-wuhan/dsh-skills-hub/main/docs/index.json` | | 备用（jsDelivr 加速） | `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/xiatian-wuhan/dsh-skills-hub@main/docs/index.json` | 或让 agent 使用 `plugin_market` 工具检索该索引。发布新版本时运行 `node scripts/make-index.mjs` 更新索引（安装源会固定到该次提交）。 ## 使用提示 - 打开面板先看顶部「目录成本 / 次请求」；点「按成本排序」找出最贵的 skill。 - 描述被标「截断」的 skill，模型只看到前 `上限-3` 个字符——把介绍写短比写全更有用。 - 长期不用又不想删的 skill，点「从目录隐藏」：成本归零，文件与 `/名字` 调用都保留。 - 「本会话已发布 N 次」数字越大，说明目录变动越多，历史里的目录副本也越多。 ## 兼容性 - 需要 **DSH ≥ 0.2.0**（使用 `ctx.shell` 的 `execute()` 接口；0.1.x 的 `run()` 仍做了兼容）。 - Web 组合里 `dsh-base` 的全局 `skill-filesystem` / `tool-skill` 被 `dsh-web-app` 关闭，技能实际由 **Agent 预设作用域**提供。因此本插件按官方规则自行扫描 project / preset / user 各技能根，并与会话里已发布的目录交叉校验；若某部署的全局 `ctx.skills` 有内容，会自动作为覆盖层合入。 ## 开发 ```bash # 生成市场索引（提交代码后运行，写入 docs/index.json） node scripts/make-index.mjs # 本地安装调试 dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/to/dsh-skills-hub ``` 仓库结构：`index.js` 是 Host 半区（HTTP 路由 + 扫描 + 成本计算），`client.js` 是浏览器半区（设置面板），`cordis.patch.yml` 声明要注入的服务。 ## English **Skills Hub** shows what every installed skill costs in the model's context — the always-present catalog line, the full catalog copy appended on each change, and the body loaded on first use — and lets you hide a skill (`disable-model-invocation`) without deleting it. It also previews the exact catalog message the model receives (byte-identical to what `dsh-tool-skill` publishes), flags descriptions truncated by the catalog cap, and reports skills that exist on disk but never reach the catalog. Install: `dsh plugin --profile web add git+https://github.com/xiatian-wuhan/dsh-skills-hub.git`, then restart `dsh web` and open **Settings → Skills Hub**. Requires DSH 0.2.0+. ## License MIT

plugins.description: 余额水杯 · Whale Balance｜DSH 插件：把 DeepSeek 账户余额显示成鲸鱼标志里上涨的水面｜DSH plugin: your account balance as water rising inside the whale mark, with spend stats, alerts and top-up.
plugins.readme_text:
# Whale Balance · 余额水杯

[English](#english) · [中文](#中文)

**English** — A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that turns your account balance into water inside the whale mark: the level fills against a full amount you set, the surface keeps rippling, and a hover panel shows exact amounts, spend, remaining days and a top-up link.

**中文** — 把 DeepSeek 账户余额显示成鲸鱼标志里上涨的水面：水位按你设置的满杯金额线性变化，水面持续荡漾；悬停面板给出精确金额、今日/近 7 天消耗、还能用几天，以及充值入口。

---

## English

### Install

From npm:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-whale-balance
```

Straight from GitHub:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "git+https://github.com/BugDesigner-Hy/dsh-whale-balance.git"
```

Then enable **Whale Balance** on the Plugins page. The plugin is also listed in the [Open Plugin Market](https://dshopen.org) — add `https://dshopen.org/index.json` under **Discover → Add index source** and search for `whale` or `balance`.

### What you get

- A 46px floating whale mark in the bottom-right corner (`shell.overlay`). Drag it anywhere; the position is remembered and clamped to the window.
- Clicking the mark unfolds it into a pill with a Casio-style LCD face on the right showing the live total: seven-segment digits, faint ghost segments, and a short digit churn when the amount changes. The pill hugs the amount instead of reserving a wide empty display. It unfolds toward the side with room — left by default, and when a dragged chip cannot fit to the right, it keeps its right edge and grows leftwards instead of leaving the window. Click again to fold it back; otherwise it stays open.
- Water height = `balance / full amount`, capped at full. The full amount is per currency and set in the panel's gear.
- Two drifting wave layers inside the whale silhouette, plus a ±4° sway of the mark so the tail moves most.
- Live balance from the account watch stream: login, top-up and sign-out push a frame immediately. Falls back to 60 s polling when the stream is unavailable.
- Hover panel: wallet totals with the bonus share in parentheses (gift icon + amount); click a currency to make it the vessel's basis. Also today's and last-7-day spend, an estimate of remaining days, a low-balance warning, refresh, and **Top up**.
- Clicking the mark only unfolds or folds the LCD face — it never navigates; top-up has its own link.
- Low balance: amber water and a soft breathing glow around the mark's edge. The threshold is either an amount or a percentage of the full amount.
- Only theme tokens for the container, focus rings and text; `prefers-reduced-motion` disables the ripples, sway, breathing glow and spinner. UI is localized (English / Chinese).

### Settings

| Setting | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Full amount | ¥100 (USD $15) | Spendable total (recharge + bonus) at which the vessel is full; set 1000 to make 1000 the top |
| Alert mode | amount | `amount` or `percent` |
| Alert threshold | ¥5 (USD $1) | Below it the water turns amber and the mark's edge glows softly |
| Percent threshold | 10% | Used in percent mode: threshold = full amount × percent |

Full amount and amount threshold are stored per currency (CNY / USD); the percentage is global. Everything lives in `localStorage` and applies immediately; **Reset** restores the defaults.

### How the level works

- Linear: `(recharge + bonus) / full amount`, capped at 1. 40 of 100 fills 40% of the height.
- Spend figures come from the balance decreases this plugin observes while the app runs, so they are an estimate, not a bill. The ledger tracks the recharge and bonus wallets together (the platform spends the bonus first), and both the today and 7-day rows are always shown — `0.00` when nothing has been observed yet.
- Days left divides the usable total (recharge + bonus) by the extrapolated daily spend from the last seven days of observations, and stays hidden until there is at least one day of history.

### Where the data comes from

The browser reads the same account Remote as **Settings → Account**:

```js
ctx.get('remote').$stream({ name: 'account', open: (signal) => account.watch(signal) })   // live state
ctx.get('remote.account').getBalance({ version, locale, timezoneOffsetSeconds })          // balance
```

No API key is stored and the plugin makes no external network requests.

### Limits

- Spend history and settings are kept in `localStorage` per origin; a desktop build that changes ports starts collecting again.
- Spend is observed only while the app is running, so long offline periods are not attributed.

### License

MIT © 2026 BugDesigner-Hy. The whale path comes from the MIT-licensed DSH client primitives (© DeepSeek); see [LICENSE](LICENSE).

---

## 中文

### 安装

从 npm：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-whale-balance
```

直接从 GitHub：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "git+https://github.com/BugDesigner-Hy/dsh-whale-balance.git"
```

装好后到 **插件** 页确认「余额水杯」已启用。也可以在 **发现 → 添加索引源** 加入社区市场 `https://dshopen.org/index.json`，搜索 whale / 余额 找到它。

### 它在哪里

`shell.overlay` 里的一块 46px 悬浮徽标，默认在窗口右下角（距边 20px），不占布局、不遮挡滚动区域。

- **拖动**：按住徽标可拖到任意位置，松手后记住坐标（窗口缩小时会自动收回可视区）。
- **点击展开**：徽标展开成一条胶囊，右侧亮起电子表风格的 LCD 实时余额（七段数字、未点亮的「幽灵段」、金额变化时数字快速滚动一下），胶囊宽度随金额自适应，不多留空白；再点一次收回，不点就一直保持展开。默认贴着右边，所以是向左展开；如果拖到了别处，会先看右侧是否放得下，放不下就固定右边缘、向左展开，绝不越出窗口。全程不做任何跳转。
- **游动**：鲸鱼以身体为轴微微摆动（约 ±4°），尾巴的摆幅最明显；`prefers-reduced-motion` 下停止。
- **悬停 / 键盘聚焦**：在水杯上方展开面板（靠近窗口顶部时自动翻到下方，靠近左侧时改为左对齐）。
- **面板右上角的齿轮**：切换到设置，改完立即生效并保存；`Esc` 先退出设置、再收起面板。

### 面板内容

| 区域 | 内容 |
| --- | --- |
| 标题行 | 标题 + 齿轮（设置）+ 刷新（读取时旋转） |
| 金额 | 各币种可用总额；赠送部分紧跟在后面，括号内以礼物图标 + 金额显示；点币种把它设为水位基准 |
| 统计 | 今日消耗、近 7 天消耗、约可用天数 |
| 提醒 | 低于阈值时出现琥珀色提示 |
| 底部 | 「去充值」+ 上次更新时间 |

### 设置（默认值可直接用）

| 设置 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 满杯金额 | ¥100（USD 为 $15） | 水位到顶对应的可用总额（充值 + 赠送）。设成 1000，就以 1000 为满杯 |
| 提醒方式 | 金额 | 可选「金额」或「百分比」 |
| 提醒阈值 | ¥5（USD 为 $1） | 低于该金额时水体转琥珀、徽标外缘持续微微发光（呼吸感） |
| 百分比阈值 | 10% | 当提醒方式为百分比时，阈值 = 满杯金额 × 该比例 |

满杯金额与金额阈值按币种分别保存（CNY / USD 各一套），百分比是全局一个；`恢复默认` 一次还原全部。设置保存在浏览器 `localStorage`，修改后立即生效，无需重启。

### 水位怎么算

- 水位：**线性**，`(充值 + 赠送) / 满杯金额`。满杯填 100、可用总额 40 就是四成高；超过满杯金额则封顶为满。
- 低余额：可用总额（充值 + 赠送）低于你设置的金额阈值，或低于满杯金额的百分比，即触发提醒。
- 「可用天数」用观察到的近 7 天消耗外推日均（历史不足 7 天按已观察天数等比外推，不足 1 天则不显示），分子是「充值 + 赠送」的可用总额，只是趋势参考。
- 消耗完全来自本插件观察到的余额变化（只在应用运行时记录），是**估算**；把它当作趋势，不要当作账单。统计把「充值余额 + 赠送余额」合在一起算（平台先扣赠送），今日与近 7 天两行始终显示，尚未观察到扣费时显示 ¥0.00 并附一行说明。

### 数据来源

浏览器端读取本应用已挂载的账户 Remote：

```js
ctx.get('remote').$stream({ name: 'account', open: (s) => account.watch(s), ... })  // 实时状态
ctx.get('remote.account').getBalance({ version, locale, timezoneOffsetSeconds })  // 余额
```

即「设置 → 账户」页用的同一条通道。登录、充值、退出都会推一帧，水位随即更新；流不可用时自动退化为每 60 秒轮询，读取失败或服务未就绪时每 5 秒重试，页面隐藏时不发请求、重新可见时立刻刷新。

插件本身不保存 API Key、不发任何外部网络请求。

### 可调常量（`client.js` 顶部）

| 常量 | 默认 | 含义 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `REFRESH_MS` | `60000` | 轮询回退的刷新间隔 |
| `RETRY_MS` | `5000` | 未就绪/失败时的重试间隔 |
| `FALLBACK_FULL` | `{ CNY: 100, USD: 15 }` | 各币种满杯金额的默认值 |
| `FLOOR_LOW` | `{ CNY: 5, USD: 1 }` | 各币种金额阈值的默认值 |
| `DEFAULT_PERCENT` | `10` | 百分比阈值的默认值 |
| `DAY_MS` | `86400000` | 统计窗口单位 |
| `WATER` / `WATER_LOW` | 蓝 / 琥珀 | 水体与水面高光配色 |

### 主题与可访问性

- 容器、文字、边框只用 `--dsw-alias-*` 主题变量，跟随明暗主题；只有水体是美术配色。
- 徽标是真正的 `<button>`：可聚焦、有含金额与低余额提示的 `aria-label`；面板关闭时用 `visibility` 隐藏，不会进入 Tab 顺序。
- 数字输入框在失焦或回车时才提交，允许中途清空；`Esc` 在输入框内只还原输入，不关闭面板。
- 面板不挡鼠标：只有打开时才接收指针事件，并有一段透明桥接区域，鼠标从徽标移进面板不会闪断。
- 尊重 `prefers-reduced-motion`：关闭波纹漂移、水位过渡、低余额呼吸光与刷新旋转。
- 文案走客户端 locale 服务（内置 en / zh）。

### 已知限制

- 消耗统计与设置存放在浏览器 `localStorage`（按 origin）。如果桌面端每次启动换端口，这些数据会重新积累。
- 「可用天数」依赖已观察到的消耗，长时间不用时消耗为 0，该项不显示。

### 文件

| 文件 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `index.js` | Host 半侧：空座位，不注册任何资源 |
| `client.js` | 浏览器半侧：水位徽标、拖动、面板、设置、余额与消耗统计 |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | 插入 `balance-vessel` 这一行 |
| `locale/en.json`、`locale/zh.json` | 插件管理器里的标题与说明 |
| `icon.svg` | 原创图标（水面与鲸尾），非官方商标素材 |
| `LICENSE` | MIT |

鲸鱼轮廓路径取自本应用自带的品牌标志（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives`，MIT，© DeepSeek），其余图形与动效为原创。

### 许可证

[MIT](LICENSE) © 2026 BugDesigner-Hy。仓库里的鲸鱼路径来自同样以 MIT 分发的 DSH 客户端素材，署名见 LICENSE。

plugins.description: Adversarial review console for DSH: independent red-team subagent + independent judge, 0-100 scoring with a 95 gate, four evidence images per round, unified redteam-console mode.
plugins.readme_text:
# 红队评审台（Red-Team Review Console）

给 DeepSeek Harness 的一个持久插件（bundle），把「对抗式挑刺 → 独立打分 → 修复 → 复评」做成可复用闭环：

```
建设者 AI 做项目（任意工作区）
   │
   ├─ adversarial_review_round（Host 工具）
   │    1. Host 用无头 Chrome 渲染恰好 4 张被评审 UI 的证据截图
   │    2. 启动「红队」子智能体（fresh 会话、只读、只证伪）挑刺
   │    3. 启动「判官」子智能体（另一个 fresh 会话，只拿红队报告）打分 0–100
   │    4. 返回 gate：总分 ≥95 + 有效发现 ≥3 + 截图 =4 + mustFix 为空 才 passed
   │
   ├─ 未通过：按判官 mustFix/扣分项修复项目，再次调用工具
   └─ 通过：允许交付/停止
```

## 交付物

| 文件 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Host 插件行 + 单一统一 Agent 预设（`redteam-console`：主会话可读写/执行；被评审台作为子代理时由 guard 强制只读；红队/判官角色由每轮任务提示区分） |
| `index.js` + `lib/` | Host：子智能体编排、4 张截图渲染、状态持久化、门控 guard、HTTP 数据接口 |
| `client.js` | Web GUI 原生面板：侧栏「红队评审台」+ 整页看板（门控横幅 / 轮次时间线 / 发现 / 评分明细 / 4 张截图） |
| `locale/`、`icon.svg` | 插件元数据与图标（中/英） |
| `CONTRACT.md` | 实现契约（接口、状态模型、门控规则） |
| `docs/UPGRADE-PLAN.md` | 问题清单（S/B/E/G/M/P 六类、带严重度）+ v1.1→v2.0 升级实施计划 |
| `test/` | 纯逻辑单测（`node --test`） |

演示对象是 `../demo-tarot-app/`（一个刻意埋了缺陷的静态站），用来真实跑完整闭环。

## 安装

在 Harness 会话中由具备权限的 Agent 执行：

```
plugin_manager install_bundle, target = C:\Users\zl\Documents\deepseek-harness\default-workspace\redteam-console
```

安装后：

- 侧栏出现「红队评审台」入口，点开是整页看板；
- 新会话的 Agent 预设选择器出现「对抗审查（红队）」「独立评分（判官）」两个独立预设；
- 所有 Agent 的工具列表出现 `adversarial_review_round` / `adversarial_review_status`；评审子智能体另有专属只读工具 `review_probe`（其他 Agent 调用会被拒绝）。

> 本地目录安装是 link 方式：改完代码需要重新 `install_bundle` 才会加载新的 Host 代码；Client 代码刷新页面生效。已有会话保持旧组合。

## 使用（任意项目）

对一个做完的项目执行一轮：

```json
{
  "target": "C:\\path\\to\\your\\project",
  "title": "项目名（可选）",
  "claims": ["README 里宣称做到的事 1", "宣称 2"],
  "focus": ["正确性", "前端密钥", "可访问性"],
  "environment": "可运行已有测试，无需联网",
  "timeBudget": "20 分钟或 40 次工具调用",
  "shots": [
    { "path": "index.html", "width": 1440, "height": 900, "name": "home-desktop" },
    { "path": "shop.html", "width": 1440, "height": 900, "name": "shop" },
    { "path": "reading.html", "width": 1440, "height": 900, "name": "reading" },
    { "path": "index.html", "width": 390, "height": 844, "name": "home-mobile" }
  ]
}
```

- `shots` 必须恰好 4 条（每轮固定 4 张证据截图）；留空则自动探测 `index.html` 等入口并用 4 个视口渲染；完全找不到 Web UI 时，先渲染 4 张中性占位报告页供评审引用，评分结束后用完整本轮结果重新渲染同一批 4 张。
- **`evidence`（v1.2，与 `shots` 二选一）**：恰好 4 张证据卡，`kind` 支持 `"screenshot" | "interaction" | "image" | "pdf-text"`。`interaction` 卡可写 `path`/`url` + `width`/`height` + `steps`（`goto` / `wait` / `click` / `key` / `screenshot`，最多 20 步）+ `collect:{console,network,perf}`，Host 用零依赖 CDP runner 真实操作页面，产出多帧截图与 console/network/perf 摘要；`image` 把项目内 PNG 图表拷入证据目录并校验尺寸/sha256；`pdf-text` 零依赖抽取论文 PDF 指定页文本，渲染成证据页并附 `.txt` 全文。每卡至少 1 张图，门控仍要求 4 张代表图。
- `profile` 支持 `code`（默认）/`web`/`game`/`modeling`，可按轮传参覆盖；`game` 注入游戏 rubric，`modeling` 注入建模 rubric（可复现性/数据泄漏/指标口径/基线/图表一致性等）。建模项目可在根目录放 `modeling-run.json`（声明复现命令 + metricsFile），评审者用 `review_probe run-metrics` 在只读临时副本真实执行并对比指标。
- **生命周期模式（v1.3）**：已通过 cycle 不会就地重审；再次评审用 `mode:"reopen"`（新 cycle、轮数重置）或 `mode:"incremental"`（基于上一通过轮快照只强制检查变更文件 + 回归抽样；无基线文件清单时自动降级全量并 warning）。`adversarial_review_batch` 可一次顺序评审 2–`maxBatchTargets` 个 target，单 target 失败不中断。
- **只读运维看板（v1.3）**：搜索/状态筛选/排序；概览、轮次、发现（降噪 suppressed/mustFix 去重）、证据（代表图 + 额外帧 + PDF 文本 artifact）、成本、导出（MD/JSON）页签；SSE 阶段进度与取消按钮；轮次 diff（new/repeat/fixed/severity-changed）；不提供 accept/reject/waive 人工处置。
- **v2.0 可信评分体系**：`judgeModels` 多模型判官路由（≤3，逐样本审计）、`scoreStats`（mean/median/stdev/CI95 bootstrap）、20 项目校准语料（`benchmarks/`，4 种子 + 16 corpus 微基准，82 条 path:line 标签，`corpus/generate.mjs --check` 可确定性重建）、校准脚本 `node benchmarks/calibrate.mjs`、漂移脚本 `node benchmarks/drift.mjs --baseline benchmarks/baseline.json`；评分口径见 [docs/SCORING-RUBRIC.md](docs/SCORING-RUBRIC.md)，最终验收见 [docs/ACCEPTANCE-REPORT.md](docs/ACCEPTANCE-REPORT.md)。live 校准 5 fixture：recall 100% / precision 92% / gate 一致 5/5，mean 47.8、CI95 [40.6,55]。
- 例：`{"target":"...", "profile":"game", "evidence":[{"kind":"interaction","path":"index.html","steps":[{"action":"goto"},{"action":"click","selector":"#start"},{"action":"screenshot","name":"playing"}],"collect":{"console":true,"perf":true}}, {"kind":"screenshot","path":"index.html","name":"desktop"}, ...]}`。
- 工具返回 `gate`：`passed=false` 时按 `score.mustFix` / `score.deductions[].fix` 修复后再次调用；`passed=true` 才能停。
- 判官独立评分（**默认 2 个独立判官**）：红队看不到判官、判官看不到红队推理、判官之间互不可见、都看不到建设者的上下文；聚合规则是保守的——分数取中位数（偶数取较低值），`mustFix` 取并集，有效发现数取「所有判官都 supported 的交集 ∪ 任一判官 supported 的 BLOCKER/MAJOR 阻断并集」去重后的数量，任一判官认定 supported 的 BLOCKER/MAJOR 都会阻断门控；判官分歧（分差 >5、mustFix/verdict 不一致）记入 `disagreement` 供审计，不改变门控。模型调用全部发生在 Host 侧，**前端不接触任何 API key**。
- 每轮记录审计字段：`rubricVersion`、攻击者/判官 prompt 的 sha256、请求的模型路由（未配置则记录继承）、判官原始分 `rawScore`、判官原始输出摘要、每个判官的独立结果 `judges[]`、`judgeSessionIds[]`。

## 门控规则

`gate.passed === true` 当且仅当：

1. 评分 ≥ `requiredScore`（默认 **95**，满分 100，**只向下取整到 0.5 档**：94.5 → 94.5，永远不会因为取整变成 95）；
2. 有效发现（判官 supported）≥ `requiredFindings`（默认 3）；**例外（v2.0 clean-pass）**：**每个**判官样本都明确报告 0 条 supported、无阻断项、`mustFix` 为空且评分 ≥ `requiredScore` 时，视为项目干净，可通过（避免「3 条 MINOR 必然 92.5」与 95 线的数学矛盾；任一样本有 1–2 条发现不适用，避免一个干净判官抹掉另一个判官的发现）；
3. 本轮截图数 = `requiredShots`（默认 4，且是真实可解析 PNG）；
4. 判官 `mustFix` 为空——**mustFix 只包含 BLOCKER/MAJOR 级阻断项**；
5. 判官没有任何 `supported` 的 **BLOCKER 或 MAJOR** 阻断项（评分再高也不能放行）。

评分口径：**95/100** 表示「没有阻断项（无 BLOCKER/MAJOR 残留）且证据充分」，允许保留少量已披露的 MINOR 并小幅扣分（每条 **2.5**，合计 ≤**7.5**）。因此 95 分线最多容忍 2 条 MINOR（3 条 = 92.5 < 95）；BLOCKER/MAJOR 仍然严格卡死。

另有 `tools.guard`：位于评审中的项目，调用者会话在未达标时 `update_goal(action: complete)` 会被拒绝；`present` 提交该项目文件也会被拒绝（可用配置关闭）。

## 配置（`cordis.patch.yml` 的 `adversarial-review-console.config`）

| 键 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `requiredScore` | `95` | 停止线（满分 100） |
| `requiredFindings` | `3` | 必须挑出的有效问题数 |
| `requiredShots` | `4` | 每轮证据卡/代表图数量 |
| `profile` | `code` | 领域 profile：`code` / `web` / `game` / `modeling`；game 注入游戏 rubric。可用 tool 参数 `profile` 按轮覆盖 |
| `interactionTimeoutSeconds` | `60` | 单张 interaction 证据卡的 CDP 交互超时（1–600s） |
| `modelingTimeoutSeconds` | `120` | `review_probe run-metrics` 单条声明命令超时（1–600s，总预算 600s） |
| `maxRounds` | `12` | 单 cycle 轮数上限（本 bundle 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 覆盖为 **40**） |
| `roundTimeoutSeconds` | `900` | 单个子智能体超时（红队/判官各自计时；上限 2160s；本 bundle 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 为适配 V4Pro 覆盖为 **1800s**） |
| `childProvider` | `spawn` | 子智能体后端（in-process spawn 才能用 preset） |
| `attackerPreset` / `judgePreset` | `redteam-console` | 统一预设 id（发布前合并；角色由任务提示区分，子代理由 Host guard 强制只读） |
| `judgeSamples` | `2` | 每轮独立判官数量（1–3）；聚合取中位/较低分、mustFix 并集、supported 取交集/阻断并集口径，分歧仅标记 |
| `readOnlyReviewers` | `true` | 评审子智能体硬只读：拒绝 shell/写/交付/联网类工具，fs 读取限制在 target + 本轮证据目录（realpath 二次校验，符号链接越界拒绝），运行测试只能走 `review_probe` |
| `probeTimeoutSeconds` | `120` | `review_probe run-tests` 超时（临时只读副本内执行，离线 env，结束清理） |
| `probeMaxCopyBytes` / `probeMaxCopyFiles` | `104857600` / `20000` | probe 临时副本上限 |
| `attackerProvider/attackerModel/attackerReasoningEffort` | `''` | 可选攻击者模型路由；留空继承父会话。只传 id，不涉及 key |
| `judgeProvider/judgeModel/judgeReasoningEffort` | `''` | 可选判官模型路由；留空继承父会话 |
| `chromePath` | `''` | 留空自动找 Chrome/Edge/ms-playwright Chromium |
| `stateDir` | `''` | 留空用 `$DSH_HOME/adversarial-review` |
| `announceToAgent` | `true` | 是否给所有 Agent 注入使用说明 |
| `enforceGoalGate` / `enforceGateOnPresent` | `true` | 未达标时拦截 stop/交付 |
| `goalGateRoots` | `[]` | 只对列出的交付根（精确匹配，不含其子目录）执行 `update_goal(complete)` 门禁；未列出的根不阻塞完成；空 = 本会话评审过的全部根。校准/演示 fixture 可排除，避免故意失败样本永久阻塞 goal |

## 演示闭环结果（本 profile 实测）

对 `demo-tarot-app/` 真实跑了 **5 轮**对抗评审（每轮固定 4 张截图，共 20 张 PNG，全部由 Host 侧无头浏览器渲染并校验）。下表中的分数为旧 10 分制轮次按 **×10** 迁移后的 100 分制显示（`rubricVersion: legacy-10`），规则与现在不完全相同，仅作历史记录：

| 轮次 | 红队发现 | 判官独立评分 | 门控 | 处理 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| R1 | 18 条（含 BLOCKER/MAJOR） | **60 / 100** BLOCK | ✗ | 18 项 mustFix 全部修复 |
| R2 | 6 条（判官驳回 1 条过度指控） | **85 / 100** HOLD | ✗ | 6 项修复（数量接线/焦点/live/移动菜单/内边距/文档） |
| R3 | 5 条（1 MAJOR + 4 MINOR） | **85 / 100** HOLD | ✗ | 5 项修复（测试口径/焦点/缩略图/空购物袋/文案） |
| R4 | 5 条（1 MAJOR + 4 MINOR） | **85 / 100** HOLD | ✗ | 1 MAJOR + 4 MINOR 修复（真实 click 集成测试/隐私日期/运费文案/焦点陷阱/缩略图断言） |
| R5 | 4 条（全部 MINOR，无阻断项） | **95 / 100** PASS | ✓ | `mustFix=[]`，`gate.passed=true`，停止 |

**历史演示（Phase 0 时）**：当时 `node test/run-all.js` 28/28、插件单测 86/86（含前端静态契约 95/95）；当前测试入口为 `node test/run-all.mjs`，Host **338/338**、含客户端契约 **366/366**（run-all.mjs 366/366），证据截图在 `$DSH_HOME/adversarial-review/shots/<cycleId>/`。

**评分口径说明**：新规则为 100 分制、95 分

plugins.description: 给 DSH Web 侧栏腾点地方。 Too many DSH plugins, too little room.
plugins.readme_text:
# toomuch-plugins **Makes room in the DSH Web sidebar.** · *Too many plugins, too little room.* [![license](https://img.shields.io/github/license/rivenshanghai/dsh-toomuch-plugins)](https://github.com/rivenshanghai/dsh-toomuch-plugins/blob/main/LICENSE) [![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%E2%89%A520-brightgreen)](https://nodejs.org) [![DeepSeek Harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-plugin-blue)](https://github.com/rivenshanghai/dsh-toomuch-plugins) [![topic](https://img.shields.io/badge/topic-dsh--plugin-8A2BE2)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin) [English](README.md) | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)
--- A small plugin set that gives the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) Web sidebar some breathing room. It ships one plugin today: | Plugin | What it does | | --- | --- | | Sidebar panel collapse | Collapses the "global panels" column above the workspace into one toggle in the sidebar footer | ## Why The DSH Web sidebar stacks, from top to bottom: brand row → new session → **global panel entries** → workspace → settings. Every plugin that adds a sidebar entry adds a row to that column: plugins, plugin market, schedules, MCP studio, context, skill manager, system monitor… Seven rows are roughly 280px, which squeezes the workspace region down to a few sessions. This plugin does exactly one thing: **collapse that column of global panel entries**, and bring it back when you need it. ## Highlights - **Collapsed by default** — the workspace gets ~280px back as soon as the plugin is installed. - **One toggle** in the sidebar footer, right above "settings". - **Remembered** in `localStorage`; survives reloads and restarts. - **Nothing else is touched** — no panel, no workspace, no host behaviour; only the display of the list element the sidebar already renders. - **Themed** with `--dsw-alias-*` tokens only, so it follows the DSH theme. - **Rail-friendly** — in the narrow 56px rail the toggle becomes a round icon button. ## Install The plugin is a repository-root package: it declares the `dsh.bundle` manifest, so DSH can install it straight from GitHub. ```sh # from GitHub dsh plugin --profile web add github:rivenshanghai/dsh-toomuch-plugins # or from a local clone git clone https://github.com/rivenshanghai/dsh-toomuch-plugins.git dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-toomuch-plugins ``` `dsh plugin` forwards to `pnpm` inside the profile. After the install, **enable the plugin** in DSH's plugin settings (it is written into the profile's `dsh.profile.bundles`), then refresh the page. From the plugin market, once listed: open **Settings → Plugin Market** in DSH and search for `toomuch-plugins`. **Verify:** the sidebar footer gains a "Collapse global panels / Expand global panels" row above "settings", and the global panel column is gone. Requirements: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) with a `web` profile; Node.js ≥ 20. ## How it works `src/client.js` does three things: 1. registers a toggle into the sidebar footer slot `sidebar.footer.action` (the row next to "settings"); 2. walks up from its own root node to find the sidebar root's direct `
` child — the global panel list — and toggles its `display`; 3. remembers the choice in `localStorage`. The basis is DSH's own `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar`: `nav.panelList` is a direct child of the sidebar root, so walking up from the footer button always reaches it. Styling uses only `--dsw-alias-*` theme variables, and the stylesheet rides inside the component, so unmounting removes it. No DSH internal package is imported, and no DSH file is modified. The full contract is written down in [docs/design.md](docs/design.md). ## Repository layout ``` . ├── package.json plugin manifest: dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client ├── cordis.patch.yml inserts the loader row into the profile ├── src/ │ ├── index.js Host half (no host capabilities needed; apply is empty) │ └── client.js Client half: footer toggle + collapse/expand logic ├── locale/{en,zh}.json title and description in the plugin list ├── docs/ design notes, market submission, pre-submit checklist ├── icon.svg icon ├── CHANGELOG.md └── LICENSE ``` ## Known limits - It collapses the **global panel entries** column only. The brand row, new session and settings are left alone — the brand row's "collapse sidebar" button is the only entry point on Linux / Windows, so hiding it would lose a feature. - With no global panels installed, the sidebar never renders that `
` and the toggle is a harmless no-op. - Verified on DSH Web (Linux) only. ## Plugin market DSH plugins are listed in the [awesome-dsh-plugin](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin) catalog, which aggregates the repositories carrying the **`dsh-plugin`** GitHub topic. Add that topic to this repository, then open a one-file pull request against that catalog: the entry file is `data/plugins/__.yml`, with a `category`, a one-line `description.en` and an optional `description.zh` (the catalog's contributing guide has the exact rules). ## Related plugins - [dsh-sidebar-quiet](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-sidebar-quiet) — folds the sidebar **footer** rows (balance / import / memory / sign out) into one line - [dsh-sidebar-buttons](https://github.com/lywusichen/dsh-sidebar-buttons) — manage sidebar footer buttons: drag to reorder, show / fold into More / hide - [dsh-sidebar-pins](https://github.com/AndreyTepaykin/dsh-sidebar-pins) — a collapsible pinned-sessions block above the settings row - [dsh-sidebar-drawer](https://github.com/1dustycy/dsh-sidebar-drawer) — an edge-hover drawer that expands the sidebar - [dsh-plugin-sidebar-visibility](https://github.com/Robert-Wang-08/dsh-plugin-sidebar-visibility) — hide / collapse at the workspace level ## Contributing Bug reports and pull requests are welcome. Please include your DSH version, the browser, and whether the toggle appeared in the sidebar footer. Keep the change focused: this plugin does one thing, and the DOM contract it relies on is documented in [docs/design.md](docs/design.md). ## License MIT © [rivenshanghai](https://github.com/rivenshanghai) — see [LICENSE](LICENSE).

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 的原生 QQ 机器人插件：微内核 + 9 个子插件，Linux/Windows 通用。收消息、发图、生图、发表情，装完就能聊。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-onebot-qq

DSH插件式的QQ机器人，经 [NapCat](https://napcat.napneko.icu/) 的 OneBot v11 协议收发消息。
微内核 + 可插拔子插件，**Linux / Windows通用**，装完在控制台填几项就能用。

![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue) ![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D22-green) ![dsh](https://img.shields.io/badge/dsh-%3E%3D0.2.1--rc.2-7c3aed)

> **先读**：[`docs/使用说明书.md`](docs/使用说明书.md)（使用说明书：安装 → 连接 → 各功能怎么用 → 人设怎么写）。
> 想自己装：本文「安装」；只想让 DSH 帮你装：把 [`docs/安装前准备.md`](docs/安装前准备.md) 甩给它。

## 特性

| 能力 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| **DSH 原生插件** | `dsh.bundle.patch` 随包声明、一行挂载；纯 in-process，无独立进程 / systemd |
| **高可塑性** | 想要什么功能自己向DSH许愿 |
| **微内核 + 自带 9 个子插件** | 门禁唤醒 / 命令 / 文件 / 人设句池 / 入群欢迎 / 生图 / 链接解析 / 表情包 / 简易群记忆；目录自动发现，坏一个不影响其他 |
| **唯一出站口** | 文本只走 `deliver()`、媒体只走 `sendMedia()`；自动抽 `[AT:]` → 六项脱敏 → 插件装饰 → 发送 + 留档 |
| **QQ 控制台** | 16 个页签、配置热改（原子写 + 备份 + 回滚）；子插件↔页面 1:1；低频配置集中「其他」页，全部带悬停解释 |
| **开箱人设** | 内置「蓝色大肥鱼」+ `_模板.md`，首次启动自动投递；唤醒词与人设词合并生效，控制台可增删 |
| **QQ 侧能力** | 收发图片、生图/图生图（`openai-images` / `openai-chat`）、群头像、表情包自动收集、入群欢迎、群记忆注入、可选链接解析 |
| **跨平台** | 路径 / 临时目录 / CQ 文件引用 / 原子写 / 人设软链降级全在 `platform/` 收口 |
| **高扩展性** | 同“可塑性” |

## 前置要求

| 组件 | 要求 |
|---|---|
| Node.js | `>= 22` |
| DSH | `>= 0.2.1-rc.2 < 0.3.0`（`engines.dsh` 声明） |
| NapCat | QQNT 客户端 + OneBot v11；需开启**正向 WebSocket** 与 **HTTP API** |
| QQ 号 | NapCat 登录用（建议小号）；机器人靠它收发消息 |

## 安装

### ① 装插件（三选一）

```bash
# GitHub（推荐）
dsh plugin --profile web add github:YUsaltyfish/dsh-onebot-qq

# 本地 tgz（npm pack 产物）
dsh plugin --profile web add /abs/path/dsh-onebot-qq-0.1.0.tgz

# 本地目录（改代码立刻生效）
dsh plugin --profile web add link:/abs/path/dsh-onebot-qq
```

也可以在 DSH 桌面端的「设置 → 插件」里填 GitHub 仓库地址安装。

> **可选**：想让 QQ 线连**全局工具**（`ops_*` / agent-team / MCP 资源）也挡住，再装配套的独立插件 `dsh-onebot-qq-opsgate`：
> `dsh plugin --profile web add github:YUsaltyfish/dsh-onebot-qq-opsgate`（必须装在 `dsh-onebot-qq` 之后）。
> 不装也能正常用，只是 QQ 会话的工具面更大，token消耗略微增加，可能导致群聊天时调用不该用的工具而产生风险。详见 [`docs/安装与卸载.md`](docs/安装与卸载.md)。

## 快速开始（4 步）

1. NapCat 登录 QQ，开启 WebSocket（默认 `ws://127.0.0.1:3001`）与 HTTP（默认 `http://127.0.0.1:3000`），记下 token（可空）。
2. DSH 设置 →「QQ 控制台」→「NapCat 连接」填地址/token → 点「测试 NapCat 连接」。
3. 「群聊」页顶部填**主人 QQ**（必填）→ 保存后自动连接。
4. 在 QQ 里 @ 机器人（或私聊）→ 有回复即可用。

> 首次启动缺 `adminQq` 会进入「待配置模式」：控制台和工具可用、不连 NapCat，填完自动连接。

## 控制台与人设

- **控制台**集成在 DSH 内置设置页，可配置程度高：16 个页签、热改即生效。
- **人设**可以直接让 AI 照随包的 `personas/_模板.md` 写一份；优秀程度看用心程度，推荐让模型多用示范对话。

## 文档

| 文档 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| [`docs/使用说明书.md`](docs/使用说明书.md) | **使用说明书（先看这个）** |
| [`docs/安装前准备.md`](docs/安装前准备.md) | 装之前：还要另外准备什么（只有 2 项）+ 验收 |
| [`docs/安装与卸载.md`](docs/安装与卸载.md) | 安装 / 升级 / 卸载 / 首次配置 |
| [`docs/配置参考.md`](docs/配置参考.md) | 实例配置 v2 全部键、路径规则、凭据、控制台热改 |
| [`docs/Windows安装.md`](docs/Windows安装.md) | Windows 从零到跑通 + 真机验证清单 |
| [`docs/排错.md`](docs/排错.md) | 连不上 NapCat、工具不出现、图片发不出 |
| [`docs/插件开发.md`](docs/插件开发.md) | 子插件契约、`bot` 能力表、五阶段、红线 |
| [`docs/架构说明.md`](docs/架构说明.md) | 实现契约（贡献者必读） |
| [`docs/运维接口.md`](docs/运维接口.md) | 可选运维外设接口（自检/清理等不进包） |

## 隐私

- 包内**不含**任何真实 QQ 号、群号、token、API Key 或服务器路径；示例都是占位值。
- 运行数据（配置、人设、表情库、群记忆、日志）都在你自己的数据目录，不进仓库、不进 npm 包。

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

---

> ⚠️ 请注意：本项目的主要贡献来自于蓝色大肥鱼——本人由于能力限制，仅通过不断“压力”大肥鱼来进行代码编写和部分细节调整。因此也诚邀同好者共同测试和维护。

> [!WARNING]
> 本插件和文档由 AI 生成，内容仅供参考，请仔细甄别。

plugins.description: OpenCode / OpenCode Go provider plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh)
plugins.readme_text:
# @goodandready/dsh-opencode-provider

OpenCode / OpenCode Go provider plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://deepseek-harness.github.io/deepseek-harness/) (dsh).

It registers two native LLM routes:

| Route | Product | Base |
|---|---|---|
| `opencode` | OpenCode Console / Zen (pay-as-you-go) | `https://opencode.ai/inference` |
| `opencode-go` | OpenCode Go / Go Plus subscription | `https://opencode.ai/inference/go` |

Requests resolve the key per call, so a changed credential reaches the next request without a restart.

## What works

- **Four wire transports**, chosen per model:
  - OpenAI Chat Completions (DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi, MiMo, LongCat, Hy3, Step, …).
  - Anthropic Messages (Claude Haiku, MiniMax, Qwen).
  - OpenAI Responses (GPT, Grok, Muse).
  - Google Generative AI (Gemini).
- **Text, reasoning, streamed tool calls, usage, finish reasons.**
- **Images** through the durable attachment service, rendered natively per transport.
- **Replay of provider metadata** where the endpoint requires it:
  - Anthropic thinking signatures.
  - Gemini `thoughtSignature` on historical function calls.
- **Multi-account rotation** before a stream starts: 401/403/429 and quota/usage-limit bodies (400/402/403/429). An invalid key cools down for 24h, a quota rejection for 10 minutes or `Retry-After`, a rate limit for 60s or `Retry-After`. A request already streaming is never replayed on another account; the next request uses the next usable key.
- **Per-account quotas**: each account row shows its own 5-hour / weekly / monthly usage, the active account drives the sidebar and quota panel, and the panel lists every account side by side.
- **Model → account rules**: first matching glob pins a preferred account for that model; the other accounts remain fallbacks if it fails or is cooling.
- **Request heatmap** in the quota panel: a Monday-first weekday × hour grid in local time, plus a 24-hour aggregate strip underneath. A selector switches between all requests and any single model. The adapter appends `{at, provider, model, purpose?}` to `~/.dsh/storages/dsh-opencode/requests.jsonl`; no prompt, response or key is stored. Auxiliary `session-title`/`compaction` calls are excluded from the heatmap and exact duplicate records collapse. The log compacts at 2 MB to the newest 5000 lines. Collection starts with this build — the projection cache only has `lastPromptAt`, not per-request timestamps.
- **Stable `x-opencode-session`** derived from the durable session id, so retries and every turn of a conversation reuse the same routing key.
- **Live catalog** from `/v1/models` with a generated `models.dev` fallback.
- **Per-model subscription limits** from the OpenCode Go pricing table: monthly dollar allowance plus estimated requests for the 5-hour, weekly and monthly windows, for both Go and Go Plus. Shown in the model picker and the settings page; estimates only — the gateway remains the authority.
- **`/opencode` command** for status, usage, accounts, models, rules, and `test [model]`.
- **TUI settings section** for the terminal profile (`/settings → OpenCode`) with the key, endpoints, allowlist, active account and timeouts.
- **Models-page key card** in Settings → Models.
- **One-click plugin update** in Settings → OpenCode: current/latest version, an update badge, and an **Update now** button that installs the exact npm version through the DSH CLI and asks for a restart. The host endpoint is `GET/POST /dsh-opencode/update`.
- **Plan-aware Go picker**: hides models outside the Go table unless turned off; descriptions carry `Go`, `Console` or `FREE`.
- **Request-wide image budget** (newest images win, oldest become an omitted placeholder) and **object-root tool-schema normalization** for MCP/third-party tools.
- **Usage analytics dashboard** in the quota panel: KPI cards (requests, tokens, success, input/output, reasoning, cache, TTFT, latency, errors), a 7/30/90 selector, and Models / Days / Sessions tables. Success and error cards show `—`: the local projection does not expose failed attempts or reasoning tokens.
- **Usage by model** from the local session projection cache: sessions and tokens per OpenCode model. Only numeric metadata is read; titles and message content stay local.
- **Browser UI**:
  - **Settings → OpenCode**: key status, paste/import/clear, quota bars, accounts, model allowlist, per-model transport overrides, connection settings.
  - **Sidebar quota card** (off by default): a ring with the active account and the highest window, then 5-hour / weekly / monthly rows with remaining quota, reset countdown and bars; clicking opens the full quota panel in the center column. The panel scrolls internally, so the heatmap and usage table below the fold stay reachable.
  - **Cost** is shown only by DSH's native cost display; the plugin does not add a second composer pill.
  - Model price badges in the settings page; the OpenCode auth-entry field autocompletes from `auth.json`.
  - Host routes under `/dsh-opencode/*` serve state and accept writes only from a loopback Host with same-origin and JSON checks; `GET /dsh-opencode/health` reports provider registration, accounts and model count.
  - The provider keeps core harness tools (`read`, `write`, `edit`, `bash`, `glob`, `grep`, …) when a large MCP set is trimmed to OpenCode's 128-tool limit.

## Install

Build and pack first:

```bash
npm install
npm run build
npm pack
```

Install the **packed tarball** into a profile:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/to/goodandready-dsh-opencode-provider-0.5.0.tgz
# DSH Desktop:
dsh plugin --profile desktop add /absolute/path/to/goodandready-dsh-opencode-provider-0.5.0.tgz

# Or install the published package:
dsh plugin --profile web add @goodandready/dsh-opencode-provider@0.5.0
```

Restart dsh (or DSH Desktop), then pick `OpenCode` or `OpenCode Go` in the model picker.

> **Use the tarball, not the directory.** On dsh 0.2.1-rc.2 the Desktop CLI aliases a local
> directory passed to `dsh plugin add` as `@deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop-runtime` and overwrites
> the target's `package.json`. Installing the packed `.tgz` avoids that path and installs
> the package under its real name.

## Verified in DSH Desktop

Tested against DSH Desktop **0.2.1-rc.2**:

- the plugin loads and `/dsh-opencode/state` returns `200`;
- the key is picked up from `~/.local/share/opencode/auth.json`;
- the live catalog returned 37 models with prices and Go limits;
- quota windows returned `rolling / weekly / monthly`;
- `/dsh-opencode/analytics` scanned 7 local sessions (0 OpenCode sessions yet, as expected before the first OpenCode chat);
- `/dsh-opencode/test` against `deepseek-v4.1-flash` returned `{"ok":true,"text":"OK"}`;
- a second Go account was added, the default key was temporarily replaced with an invalid one, and `/test` rotated to the second account and still returned `OK`;
- the second account was already at ~98% of its monthly allowance; the rotation test pushed it over, so a later run surfaced `QUOTA`, marked the default as `invalid-credential` and `Go #2` as `quota` until its reset (22 Oct 08:21), with no active account;
- per-account usage returned `default` 1% / 5% / 2% and `Go #2` 9% / 4% / **100%** monthly (`rate-limited`, reset 22 Oct 08:21), so the exhausted account is visible without a failed request;
- two `/test` requests produced `Tue 13:00 = 2` in the heatmap and two lines in `requests.jsonl`; the 24-hour strip shows the same value at 13:00;
- a third request with `minimax-m3.1-flash-free` added a second per-model series (`deepseek-v4.1-flash` 2, `minimax-m3.1-flash-free` 1), so the model selector is populated;
- after restarting Desktop, `Go #2` still showed its persisted `quota` cooldown (until 22 Oct 08:21) while the restored default key was active;
- setting `*free* → Go #2` through `/config` returned the normalized rule from `/state`, and clearing it returned `[]`; the account list stayed unchanged;
- the redesigned sidebar card was checked in Desktop: `OpenCode Go` with a 5% ring, `5-Hour Window 99% remaining · 3h`, `Weekly Window 95% remaining · 6d`, `Monthly Window 98% remaining · 29d`; it uses the DSH theme variables and matches the clinebo

plugins.description: Zero-token scheduled script runner for DeepSeek Harness (dsh-plugin): cron in the Host, no model calls, wake-on-change
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-noagent-schedule

**Run shell scripts on a schedule inside DeepSeek Harness — with no model call and no token cost.**

Every scheduling plugin in the DSH ecosystem delivers a message to a session or starts a new one,
so a cron tick always means a model wake-up. This plugin takes the other path: the Host runs the
command itself, the way `systemd` or `launchd` would. The model is only involved when you actually
want it to be — see [wake on change](#wake-on-change).

[简体中文](README.zh.md)

## What it gives you

| | |
|---|---|
| **Zero token** | A tick that runs a script costs nothing. The plugin never touches the LLM services. |
| **Cron or interval** | Five-field Vixie cron (`*/15 9-17 * * 1-5`, `sun..sat`, `jan..dec`) or `everySeconds`. |
| **Explicit time zones** | IANA zones per job, so the schedule means what it says regardless of where the Host runs. |
| **Logs you can read** | One file per run with argv, exit code, stdout and stderr; a `runs.jsonl` ledger beside it. |
| **Overlap protection** | A job whose previous run is still going is skipped, not stacked. |
| **Timeout** | Oversized jobs are terminated at `timeoutSeconds`. |
| **Settings page and sidebar panel** | Browse jobs, see last exit code and duration, run one now, read its log. |
| **Agent tools** | `noagent_status`, `noagent_run`, `noagent_log` — the same operations the UI uses. |
| **Wake on change** | Turn a polling script into an event source: the model is woken only when its output changes. |

## Install

### From the plugin market (Discover)

Open **Plugins > Discover > Manage index sources** and add:

```
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/monkey-sking/dsh-noagent-schedule/main/index.json
```

The bundle then appears in the Discover list with its description and icon, and installs like any other entry. (The Discover tab needs the experimental plugin-market bundle enabled.)

### From a checkout

```
git clone https://github.com/monkey-sking/dsh-noagent-schedule.git
plugin_manager({ action: "install_bundle", target: "<cloned directory>" })
```

Or point `target` at a checkout of this repository.

Nothing is scheduled until you write a job file.

## Where things live

| | Default | Configure |
|---|---|---|
| Job list | `~/.dsh/noagent/jobs.json` | `jobsFile` |
| State and logs | `~/.dsh/noagent/state/` | `stateDir` |

The job file is re-read every 10 seconds, so adding, editing or disabling a job needs no restart.

```
state/
├── state.json              # per job: last start, exit code, duration, fingerprint
├── runs.jsonl              # one line per run
└── runs/<job-id>/<ts>.log  # full stdout/stderr of that run
```

## Jobs

```json
{
  "jobs": [
    {
      "id": "nightly-backup",
      "name": "Nightly backup",
      "enabled": true,
      "cron": "0 3 * * *",
      "timeZone": "Asia/Shanghai",
      "cwd": "/srv/app",
      "command": "bash scripts/backup.sh",
      "timeoutSeconds": 600
    }
  ]
}
```

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `id` | Unique, also the log directory name. Required. |
| `cron` | Five fields: minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week. Supports `*/n`, `a-b`, `a-b/n`, lists, `sun..sat`, `jan..dec`. |
| `everySeconds` | Fixed interval, minimum 30. Use instead of `cron`. |
| `timeZone` | IANA zone. Defaults to the plugin's `defaultTimeZone`. |
| `cwd` | Working directory. Defaults to the user's home. |
| `command` | Run through `/bin/bash -lc`. Alternatively use `argv` for an exact process. |
| `argv` | Array form; no shell involved. |
| `env` | Extra environment variables, merged over the inherited environment. |
| `timeoutSeconds` | Terminate after this long. Default 300. |
| `enabled` | `false` keeps the job in the file but does not schedule it. |
| `wakeOnChange` | See below. |

### Why `bash -lc`

A GUI-launched Host inherits a minimal `PATH` — often just `/usr/bin:/bin`. A login shell picks up
the user's profile, so `git`, `node`, `python3` and friends resolve the way they do in a terminal.
Homebrew's standard prefixes are prepended as a fallback.

If you would rather not depend on shell startup files, use `argv` with absolute paths.

## Wake on change

A polling script usually answers one question: *did anything change?* Running it on a timer is
free; waking a model to ask the same question every few minutes is not.

`wakeOnChange` separates the two:

```json
{
  "id": "inbox-watch",
  "everySeconds": 120,
  "command": "bash scripts/probe-inbox.sh",
  "wakeOnChange": {
    "sessionId": "session-…",
    "title": "New mail",
    "prompt": "The probe found something new:\n\n{{output}}\n\nHandle it per the usual routine; reply [SILENT] if nothing needs doing.",
    "ignoreLines": ["^ts=", "progress: \\d+%"]
  }
}
```

How it behaves:

- The probe runs every 120 seconds. **No change means no model call at all.**
- Output is normalised (lines matching `ignoreLines` are dropped), then fingerprinted.
- A changed fingerprint schedules a one-shot delivery to `sessionId` about a second later, carrying
  the probe output through `{{output}}`.
- The first run only records a baseline, so installing the plugin does not immediately wake anyone.
  Set `notifyOnFirstRun: true` to opt in.
- A non-zero exit is never treated as "something changed" — failures show up in the log and the
  status, not as false wakes.
- Every wake is a one-shot scheduled delivery, and one-shot rows stay in the Host's task table
  after delivery. The plugin deletes each wake row once it has been delivered (the previous row is
  removed before the next wake, delivered rows are swept every 30 seconds, and leftovers from an
  earlier version are cleaned on the first tick), so "automation tasks" keeps listing only the real
  recurring jobs instead of a wall of identical one-shot entries.
- Empty output means nothing to report.
- `onlyOnNew` can be narrowed with `keyPattern`: only the matched part of each line identifies an
  entry, so a conversation whose last message changes (including our own reply) is not "new"; only a
  genuinely new conversation wakes the session. Lines unmatched by the pattern fall back to the
  whole line.

Placeholders in `prompt` and `title`: `{{job}}` (name), `{{id}}` (id), `{{output}}` (truncated to
4000 characters).

The target session receives an ordinary scheduled message, so anything that already works with a
scheduled delivery works here.

## UI

- **Settings → No-Agent Schedule** — one page listing every job.
- **Sidebar → clock icon** — the same list as a panel.

Both show the schedule, time zone, command, last run (time, exit code, duration), a *Run now*
button and a *Show last log* toggle. The panel refreshes every five seconds while open.

## Agent tools

| Tool | Does |
|---|---|
| `noagent_status` | List jobs with their last run. Pass `id` for one job. |
| `noagent_run` | Run one job immediately, outside its schedule. |
| `noagent_log` | Read the tail of a job's most recent log. |

The UI and the tools call the same Host implementation.

## Limits

- **Runs only while DSH is running.** A tick missed because the Host was closed is not caught up on
  restart. For a watchdog that must survive the app being closed, use `launchd`, `systemd` or
  `cron` instead — that is what they are for.
- **Not a sandbox.** Jobs run with the Host's own permissions. Treat the job file as executable
  configuration.
- **macOS may still refuse access.** A Host process inherits the app's TCC grants; a job touching a
  protected location can fail where a terminal would succeed, and vice versa. Read the log rather
  than assuming.

## Licence

MIT.

plugins.description: Account balance, session spend and turn estimate pill for the DeepSeek Harness composer dock
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-account-balance

给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（DSH）的会话输入框下面加一条余额统计：
**余额 · 会话消耗 · 本轮估算**，点一下展开明细面板。

![统计行](docs/dock.png)

![明细面板](docs/panel.png)

> 截图是示意图，数字为虚构值。

## 功能

- **余额**：`ctx.remote.account.getBalance`，与「设置 → 账号与余额」同一个 Host 接口，金额为充值余额 + 赠金余额的合计。
- **会话**：这个会话累计消耗，按「余额相对打开本会话时的减少量」计算；基线按 sessionId 存在 `localStorage`，切换会话、刷新窗口都不串不清零，充值会把基线抬高，不会出现负数。
- **本轮**：本轮 token ÷ 全会话 token × 会话消耗。Host 没有逐轮账单，这一项是分摊估算；分母用全日志的 `tokenUsage` 投影，翻页和压缩都不会让比例跑偏。
- **低余额变红**：低于 5（`LOW_BALANCE_CENTS = 500`，按各币种最小单位，即 ¥5 / $5）时「余额」那一段变红，用的是 DSH 自己的 `--dsw-alias-state-error-primary`。
- **点击面板**：真 `<button>` + portal，Escape / 点面板外 / 再点一次关闭；面板里能刷新，并跳到「查询用量 / 去充值」（链接与设置页同源）。
- 未登录、接口失败或没有钱包时整条隐藏，不留空占位。

## 安装

### 方式一：插件页

1. 下载 `dsh-plugin-account-balance-1.0.0.tgz`（或直接 `git clone` 本仓库）。
2. DSH → 侧栏 **插件** → **添加插件** → 选这个包 / 本地目录。
3. 安装完成后点 **立即启用**，刷新一次窗口。

### 方式二：命令行

```bash
node install.mjs                   # 装到 ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop
node install.mjs --profile web     # 装到指定 profile
node install.mjs --uninstall       # 卸载
```

脚本会把包复制进 profile 的 `node_modules`，把包名写进 `dsh.profile.bundles`，
并清掉早期手工安装留在 `cordis.patch.yml` 里的那一行（避免同一入口装两次）。

> 两种方式不要叠加：包已经在 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里后，就不要再往 `cordis.patch.yml` 加 `ui-account-balance` 行。

## 配置

| 想改什么 | 改哪里 |
| --- | --- |
| 变红的阈值 | `lib/client.js` 的 `LOW_BALANCE_CENTS`（500 = ¥5） |
| 刷新频率 | `lib/client.js` 的 `REFRESH_MS`（默认 60000） |
| 文案 | `lib/client.js` 里的 `t("中文", "English")` |
| 上报的客户端版本 | `lib/client.js` 的 `CLIENT_VERSION` |

改完跑一次 `node install.mjs`，再刷新窗口（profile 配置会热加载，但浏览器 bundle 不会自己热更）。
不想刷新可以在插件页把这一项关掉再打开，让条目重新挂载。

## 开发

```bash
node test/client.test.mjs     # 11 项单测：注册、渲染、面板、金额格式化、低余额、未登录降级
```

结构：

| 路径 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `package.json` | `dsh.bundle.patch`（bundle 层）+ `dsh.client`（web 客户端半侧） |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | bundle 层插入 `ui-account-balance` 行 |
| `lib/index.js` | Host 半侧，无行为 |
| `lib/client.js` | 浏览器 bundle：注册 `conversation.composer.dock` 条目、读余额、算会话/本轮、渲染面板 |
| `test/client.test.mjs` | 用 Node 跑的最小渲染测试 |
| `install.mjs` | 命令行安装/卸载 |

## 兼容性

在 DSH `0.2.1-rc.2`（桌面版）上验证。插件依赖 `remote.account` 服务，只对 DeepSeek 账号模式生效。
包里硬编码了 `CLIENT_VERSION`；如果 DSH 大版本变化后连「设置 → 账号与余额」都打不开，把它改成对应版本再试。

## Known limitations

- 「会话」是余额差，不是账单：同一时间跑的其它会话、后台任务、子智能体的消耗也算在当前这条里。
- 「本轮」按 token 占比分摊：cache 命中、未缓存输入、输出单价不同，均摊会抹平差异，适合看量级不适合对账。
- 打开旧会话时基线从此刻起算，历史消耗不追溯。

## License

MIT

# dsh-life-decision-guide

把 [eternity4719/HowToLiveBetter](https://github.com/eternity4719/HowToLiveBetter) 的 `skills/life-decision-guide` 移植成 DeepSeek Harness 插件：注册一个同名 Skill + 三个查询工具，让模型**先查书再回答**，每条注明第几节第几条，查不到就说书里没写。

全书 765 条正文随包内置，装好即用，不需要联网、不需要 clone。

## 组成

| 文件 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `skill/SKILL.md` | 指令层：安全分流 + 检索步骤 + 写作纪律 + 边界 |
| `lib/corpus.js` | 语料加载、解析、检索、性价比档计算（纯 ESM，零依赖） |
| `index.js` | 插件入口，注册 skill 与三个工具 |
| `vendor/HowToLiveBetter/` | 语料快照（book 34 节 + README + 版本记录 + 许可） |
| `tools/check.mjs` | 快照完整性校验（765 条 + 证据/性价比分布） |

工具：

| 工具 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `life_guide_toc` | 34 节目录（节号 / 节名 / 问题 / 条数） |
| `life_guide_find` | 关键词 + 可选节号检索，返回紧凑命中（含性价比档） |
| `life_guide_read` | 按 id 取整条原文（含备注、来源），数字照抄用 |

## 安装

**npm（推荐）**

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-life-decision-guide
```

**GitHub 直装**（npm 不可用时的备选）

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:MonkeyGarry/dsh-life-decision-guide
```

或在 DSH 的 **Settings → Plugin Market** 里搜 `dsh-life-decision-guide`。

**本地开发**

让 Agent 用 `plugin_manager` 的 `install_bundle`，`target` 传本目录绝对路径（本地目录会以链接方式安装，改代码立即生效）。

装好后新会话的 skill 编目会出现 `life-decision-guide`，也可用 `/life-decision-guide` 显式触发。

## 语料

发布包已内置 `vendor/HowToLiveBetter`，普通用户不需要做任何事。

维护者更新快照（注意：快照目录已**不含 `.git`**，不能 `git pull`）：

```bash
# 1) 克隆到临时目录
tmp=$(mktemp -d)
git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/eternity4719/HowToLiveBetter.git "$tmp/hltb"

# 2) 只覆盖运行时需要的文件
cp "$tmp"/hltb/book/*.md vendor/HowToLiveBetter/book/
cp "$tmp"/hltb/README.md vendor/HowToLiveBetter/

# 3) 更新版本记录（短 sha · 日期）
git -C "$tmp/hltb" rev-parse --short HEAD
printf '%s · %s\n' "<短sha>" "$(date +%F)" > vendor/HowToLiveBetter/VERSION

# 4) 校验
node tools/check.mjs
```

期望输出 `校验通过：34 节 / 765 条，证据与性价比分布吻合。` 分布不符说明正文变了，先核对再发版。

PowerShell 版对应命令：

```powershell
$tmp = Join-Path $env:TEMP "hltb"
Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $tmp -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/eternity4719/HowToLiveBetter.git $tmp
Copy-Item "$tmp\book\*" vendor\HowToLiveBetter\book\ -Force
Copy-Item "$tmp\README.md" vendor\HowToLiveBetter\ -Force
git -C $tmp rev-parse --short HEAD
```

## 发布与维护

### npm 发布

本项目**默认源是国内镜像（npmmirror，只读）**，发布必须显式指向官方源：

```bash
npm publish --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org
```

账号开了 2FA 时，二选一：

- 验证器 App（TOTP）：`npm publish --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org --otp=六位码`
- passkey / 安全密钥：命令行给不了码，改用 **Granular Access Token**，在 npm 网页上勾选 *Allow this token to bypass 2FA*，然后写进 `~/.npmrc`：
  ```
  //registry.npmjs.org/:_authToken=npm_你的token
  ```
  首包发布时 token 的包范围要选 **All packages**（包还不存在，选不到具体包）。

### 审核与占位版本

新账号首发可能进入 staged review：registry 上先出现 `0.0.0-stage` 占位版本（345 字节空壳），真实版本待审。查状态：

```bash
npm view dsh-life-decision-guide versions
npm view dsh-life-decision-guide dist-tags
```

`0.1.0` 出现在 `versions`、`latest` 变成 `0.1.0` 即通过。期间**不要重复发同一版本**，审核通过前也别装 npm 版（会装到空壳）。

> 本包 `0.1.0` 已通过审核上线：fileCount 50、unpackedSize 2.58 MB，`vendor/` 语料在包内。

### 发新版本

```bash
# 1) 改 package.json 的 version（如 0.1.1）
# 2) 更新快照（见上一节）并跑 tools/check.mjs
# 3) 提交
git add -A && git commit -m "chore: refresh corpus to <sha>" && git push
# 4) 发布
npm publish --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org
```

### 提交到插件市场

市场读的是 [awesome-dsh-plugin](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin) 的注册表，PR 加一条：

```yaml
- name: dsh-life-decision-guide
  owner: MonkeyGarry
  url: https://github.com/MonkeyGarry/dsh-life-decision-guide
  category: skill
  description:
    en: Answers real-life decisions from the 高性价比人生指南 book: looks up entries first, ranks by cost and benefit, cites section and item.
    zh: 按《高性价比人生指南》正文回答人生决策：先查条目、按成本与收益排序，每条注明第几节第几条。
  npm: dsh-life-decision-guide
  install: dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-life-decision-guide
```

### 关于 engines.dsh

未声明 `engines.dsh`：DSH 当前版本号带预发布标签（如 `0.2.1-rc.2`），semver 范围容易误判，而 `engines.dsh` 不满足会**直接阻断安装**，所以首版不写。插件在 `0.2.1-rc.2` 上验证通过。

## 上游、许可与非官方声明

**非官方实现。** 本插件由第三方基于《高性价比人生指南》制作，与原作者无关，未获其背书，也不代表原作者的观点。

- 上游：https://github.com/eternity4719/HowToLiveBetter
- 快照：commit `5f210ca9`，2026-10-20（记录在 `vendor/HowToLiveBetter/VERSION`）
- 正文（`book/`、`README.md`）：CC BY 4.0，逐字未改，署名《高性价比人生指南》并附许可证链接。
- 指令层（`skill/SKILL.md`）与档位算法（`lib/corpus.js` 的 `COST_W`/`e.ratio`）：改编/取自原仓库 `skills/` 与 `index.html`，依 MIT 保留 `Copyright (c) 2026 eternity4719` 及许可全文。
- 完整声明见 `NOTICE`。

本插件不替代医生、律师、会计。

plugins.description: DSH 表情包插件：默认表情 + 社区梗图双包，输入区一键发送，模型也能理解并回发。

# DeepSeek Meme 🐳

> 给 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）做一个像微信 / QQ 那样的表情包插件：**主人一键发，鲸鱼娘看得懂，还能回发**。

![status](https://img.shields.io/badge/status-v0.3.5-1d6bb8)
![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-0b2a5b)

## 这是什么

DSH 的对话里一直没有“表情包”这个位置：用户只能打字，模型看不懂别人贴的图，也谈不上用表情回话。DeepSeek Meme 想补上这一块：

1. **模型选择栏旁的入口**：一个小按钮，点开就是表情面板，点一下表情立即发出。
2. **一键添加**：选择图片文件即可收藏进表情包，按包分组；名称和含义可以随手补。
3. **模型能理解**：每个表情都带 `name / meaning / tags`，用户发图时会以可读文字把含义带进对话；模型也有 `send_sticker` 工具，能反过来给主人发表情。
4. **两套随包表情**：默认包「默认表情」是 GPT 绘制的 10 张鲸鱼娘日常/工作贴纸；另有「鲸鱼娘二创梗图」8 张社区二创梗图，两个包独立保留，模型都能读懂梗义并和你互发。
5. **本地优先**：表情素材保存在本机 `DSH_HOME/memes`，不联网抓取，不上传第三方。

> 当前状态：**v0.3.5 双包版 / 公开仓库**。默认包「默认表情」10 张、社区二创包 8 张；用户点表情**只发图片、不带含义文字**，并通过附件服务缩到 **180px** 后入会话（普通图片仍按原生 240px 上限显示）；模型发的贴纸会以 **150px 内联小图**放进回复开头，不再藏在折叠的工具卡里。视觉验收（按钮位置、面板样式、深浅色主题）仍需要你在页面上实际看一眼；详见 [验证记录](docs/VERIFICATION.md)。

## 功能清单

| 功能 | 状态 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 模型选择栏旁表情按钮 | ✅ 已实现 | 挂在 `conversation.input.right` 槽位 |
| 表情面板（分类 / 网格 / 添加 / 编辑） | ✅ 已实现 | 挂在 `conversation.input.dock` 槽位 |
| 点击表情一键发送 | ✅ 已验证 | 只发图片、不带含义文字；通过附件服务缩到 180px 再入会话，普通图片不受影响 |
| 表情消息尺寸 | ✅ 可配置 | 用户发送默认 180px（`messageStickerSize`，96–240）；模型发送在工具卡内显示 150px |
| 一键添加本地图片 | ✅ 已实现 | 支持 PNG / JPEG / WebP / GIF，上传/改/删均已冒烟 |
| 表情编辑（名称 / 含义 / 标签 / 移动包） | ✅ 已实现 | 面板内弹层编辑 |
| `send_sticker` 模型工具 | ✅ 已验证 | 目录查询与发表情均实测通过 |
| 随包表情包 | ✅ 已收录 | 默认包「默认表情」10 张 GPT 绘制贴纸 + 「鲸鱼娘二创梗图」8 张社区二创，两个 bundled 包独立保留 |
| 模型理解用户表情 | ✅ 已实现 | 用户表情是纯图片消息，模型看图理解；含义保留在目录，需要时用工具查询 |
| 视觉验收（真实页面） | ⚠️ 待用户确认 | 当前环境无法截图；见验证记录 |

## 项目结构

```text
DeepSeek-meme/
├─ index.js              # Host 半：存储、HTTP 路由、send_sticker 工具、提示词
├─ client.js             # Web Client 半：按钮、面板、工具卡片渲染
├─ cordis.patch.yml      # bundle patch：插入一条 Host 插件行
├─ package.json          # DSH bundle / client 清单
├─ locale/               # 插件管理页显示用的标题与描述
├─ assets/
│  ├─ default/            # 默认包「默认表情」（GPT 绘制 10 张，首次运行播种）
│  ├─ community/          # 社区二创包「鲸鱼娘二创梗图」（8 张）
│  └─ gpt/                # 两张 GPT 原图的拆分源 PNG（不随 npm 包分发）
└─ docs/
   ├─ ARCHITECTURE.md    # 架构、数据模型、会话写入策略、槽位选择
   ├─ API.md             # /api/memes 路由契约
   ├─ ASSETS.md          # 两套表情含义、来源说明与替换方法
   ├─ DEVELOPMENT.md     # 开发、安装、验证、Git 工作流
   ├─ VERIFICATION.md    # 实测证据与限制
   └─ ROADMAP.md         # 里程碑与范围
```

## 快速开始

公开安装（GitHub）：

```powershell
dsh plugin add github:FeWOO/DeepSeek-meme
```

当前这台机器已安装到 `desktop` profile（本地目录链接）。更新 Host 代码后需要重启 DSH，或对插件行做一次 disable → enable，才会加载新的 Node 模块；Client 改动在当前环境通常随 HMR 生效。

```powershell
# 语法检查
node --check index.js
node --check client.js

# 手动安装（已经装过就跳过）
#   plugin_manager install_bundle target = "D:\Kz\DeepSeek Harness\DeepSeek-meme"

# 健康检查
Invoke-RestMethod "http://127.0.0.1:4652/api/memes/health"
```

安装、验证与排错的完整步骤见 [docs/DEVELOPMENT.md](docs/DEVELOPMENT.md)，本轮实测证据见 [docs/VERIFICATION.md](docs/VERIFICATION.md)。

## 设计原则

- **不伪造会话事件**：用户表情走正常的用户消息，模型表情走 `send_sticker` 工具结果；不往 Session 里塞未知事件类型。
- **看起来是 DSH 的一部分**：只用 `--dsw-alias-*` 主题 token，布局与原生输入区一致；不加载 Harness Client 私有包。
- **模型上下文要省**：系统提示只说明“有表情包工具 + 如何查目录”，完整目录按需通过工具查询。
- **数据是本地的**：素材与目录都在 `DSH_HOME/memes`，目录写入采用临时文件 + 原子替换。

## 文档

- [架构设计](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md)
- [HTTP API 契约](docs/API.md)
- [默认梗图含义与替换](docs/ASSETS.md)
- [开发与验证](docs/DEVELOPMENT.md)
- [验证记录](docs/VERIFICATION.md)
- [路线图](docs/ROADMAP.md)
- [变更日志](CHANGELOG.md)

## License

[MIT](LICENSE) © 2026 FeWOO

[![](https://img.shields.io/badge/powered_by-dsh-4D6BFE?style=flat-square&logo=deepseek&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)

# dsh-markboard · conversation marks for DSH

[中文](./README.zh.md) | English

A **conversation markboard** for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) Web UI: turn any conversation turn into a named task card, jump straight back to it later, or quote its answer into the composer and keep working. Marks live in your browser.

> Stop scrolling through history to find "that conclusion from earlier". Mark it once, then pick from a handful of rows.

## Screenshots

| Mark action on each turn + header count | The markboard in the right Sidebar |
|---|---|
| ![marked](docs/e2e/02-marked.png) | ![panel](docs/e2e/03-panel.png) |

| Fill the composer from a card | Jump back to the turn |
|---|---|
| ![filled](docs/e2e/04-filled.png) | ![jump](docs/e2e/05-jump.png) |

## Features

- **Mark a whole turn** — a Mark action under every completed answer records the turn (your prompt plus this turn's answer) and names it from the prompt's first sentence. Click again to remove it.
- **Header count** — the Session header shows how many turns are marked; click it to open the board.
- **Right-Sidebar page** — its own tab beside Files and Browser, with "this session" / "all sessions" scopes and search over labels, content, and turn numbers.
- **Rename and delete** — click a card's title to rename it; deletion comes with an undo.
- **Jump back** — opens the owning session and scrolls the turn into view. When that turn is outside the loaded window, history is paged in first through the kernel's exact `loadThrough(seq)`, and the landing row flashes once.
- **Fill the composer** — writes the turn's answer into the current draft as a plain-text quote (`> 标记 · session · turn N`) that you can keep editing or delete; the previous draft is restorable.
- **Cross-tab sync** — another tab of the same origin writing marks updates this one.
- **Bilingual** copy that follows the interface language.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-markboard
```

Then restart `dsh web`. The plugin adds itself to the profile's bundle layer; nothing else to configure.

From a local checkout:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add file:/absolute/path/to/dsh-markboard
```

## Usage

1. Find the turn you want to keep and click **Mark** in the action row under the answer.
2. The header shows a count; click it (or press `Ctrl+Alt+M`) to open the markboard.
3. Each card offers **Jump** (back to the turn), **Fill composer** (quote the answer into the draft), and **Delete** (undoable).
4. Click a card's title to rename it — the label is your task name.

## Shortcut

`Ctrl+Alt+M` (`⌘+Alt+M` on macOS) toggles the board. The binding is editable under Settings → Shortcuts.

## How it works

Two halves, like any DSH surface plugin:

- **Host half** (`lib/index.js`): an empty `apply`. It only makes the package an ordinary Loader entry, which is what lets `client-modules` discover the `dsh.client` declaration in `package.json` and compose the browser half into `window.__DSH_BOOT__`.
- **Browser half** (`src/client`, built to `lib/client.js`): registers three existing extension seats plus a `ctx.markboard` service.

| Place | Seat | What it adds |
|---|---|---|
| Turn action row | `conversation.chat.turnTail` | the Mark / Marked button |
| Session header | `conversation.session.header.utilities` | the mark count entry |
| Right Sidebar | `ctx.sidebarRightTabs` + `sidebar.right.pane.tab` | the markboard page |
| Notices | `shell.overlay` | mark / fill / delete toasts with undo |

The data model is pure functions (`src/shared/marks.ts`); `sessionId + turn` is the identity, so marking the same turn twice edits that card instead of adding a second one. Marks persist in `localStorage['dsh-markboard.v1']`. A failed write (quota, private mode) only reports — it never throws, and the in-memory list keeps working.

**Why not Host storage**: a personal board does not need cross-device sync, and the cost of localStorage is only that a different browser or origin starts empty — which the panel says out loud.

**Why the fill is plain text**: `insertText` / `setDraft` are the kernel's public action face. A rich quote chip would need kernel support for reference fragments — a different order of change that would also drift across kernel upgrades.

## Development

```sh
npm install     # esbuild, build-time only
npm run build   # src/client → lib/client.js (wrapped as window.__ModuleLoader__.load)
npm test        # data model and persistence rules (Node's own test runner)
```

End-to-end (**opens a real browser window** so you can watch the flow):

```sh
# 1. boot a disposable DSH home so your own sessions stay untouched
DSH_HOME=/path/to/disposable/home dsh --profile e2e --port 3099 --no-open

# 2. in another shell, hand the printed token URL to the script
node tests/e2e-headed.mjs --url "http://127.0.0.1:3099/?token=…" --slow 700
```

The script walks through: open a session → mark → open the panel → rename → fill the composer → jump back → reload → search → delete and undo, writing one screenshot per stage to `docs/e2e/`. Add `--headless` for CI.

## Known limitations

- **Turns only.** No per-message or text-selection marks; a per-sentence grain makes the card list unreadable fast.
- **Local to this browser.** No cross-browser or cross-origin sharing, and no export.
- **Jumping depends on the turn's row existing**: a turn outside the loaded window triggers one exact history page-in first; if that fails the UI says so instead of failing silently.
- **The fill is a plain-text quote** and does not carry the original message's attachments or images.
- **The page is bound to a Session**: it follows session switches, and "all sessions" is a view inside the same page.
- **`Ctrl+Alt+M` only.** The shell's shortcut registry rejects a Web default that lacks the platform primary on Linux, so the Linux Web profile stays unbound rather than registering a rejected key.

## License

[MIT](./LICENSE)

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: dispatch work to DSH agents from Claude Code / Codex — native subagent progress, in-host worker sessions with per-tier presets, and a multimodal bridge that lends the text-only harness vision and image generation.
plugins.readme_text:
DSH Crew

A DeepSeek Harness plugin: dispatch work to DSH agents from Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Grok, without giving up the host's native subagent UI.
Native Progress UI • Tier Policy & Escalation • Dispatch Guardrails • Jobs Board • In-Host DSH Sessions • Vision & Image Gen (Native-First) • One-Click Install

npm: @zseven-w/dsh-crew · Current plugin release: 0.1.0-rc.11 · Tested with DSH 0.1.1-rc.1

English · 简体中文 · 繁體中文 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Français · Español · Deutsch · Português · Русский · हिन्दी · Türkçe · ไทย · Tiếng Việt · Bahasa Indonesia


The DSH Crew settings page — host integrations, dispatch policy, execution and the multimodal bridge

## Why DSH Crew DSH Crew is a plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) — an open-source agent harness. It makes DSH agents dispatchable from Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity and Grok: the orchestrator keeps its own model, the work runs on a real DSH agent with that harness's tools, sandbox, presets and session history, and the host still shows it as a native subagent with live progress. What runs the work is a DSH agent, not a bare model call. Tiers (`flash` / `pro`) select how much capability that agent gets from the harness's configured roster — DeepSeek V4 Flash and V4 Pro today — so a change of model in DSH needs no change here.
### 🧵 Native Progress UI Workers appear as regular subagents in Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Grok — dispatch count, running step, tool calls and token usage all show up in the host's own task panel, plus a claude-hud statusline segment: `⚙dsh 1▶pro 2m14s 21.7k/606 ✓3`. ### 🎚️ Tier Policy and Escalation `flash` for mechanical work, `pro` for reasoning, `effort` from `off` to `max`. `tier_policy` can clamp every dispatch to one tier at the tool layer, and `escalate_on_failure` retries a failed flash run once on pro — based on evidence, not on guessing difficulty up front.
### 🏛️ In-Host DSH Sessions With the bundle installed in a DSH profile, each worker is a first-class DSH session: visible in the Web UI, grouped by working directory, mounted with the Agent preset you choose per tier. Without DSH running, dispatch falls back to a standalone DSH runtime, so CI and headless environments still work. ### 👁️ Vision and Image Generation DSH's models are text-only. `describe_image` now prefers DeepSeek's own VL model (`deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp`) whenever a key is available, then falls back to the CLIs you already have — Claude, Codex, Grok, Antigravity — or any OpenAI-compatible API you configure. `generate_image` borrows the same CLIs' brush. Pasted images stay visible in the conversation and reach the model as text.
### 🛡️ Dispatch Guardrails Every dispatch is checked before anything spawns. Worker→worker nesting is capped at origin-chain depth 3 and cycles are refused; a second worker on a workspace another job already holds is refused with the holder's info — never silently queued. Refusals are readable errors: wait or re-scope, don't bypass. ### 📋 Jobs Board The DSH Crew panel doubles as a jobs board: every worker job — running or finished — is listed with tier, effort, live progress and tokens, held workspaces show their holders, and a job that vanishes mid-flight (e.g. a hub restart) is surfaced as an orphan ghost instead of disappearing silently.
### 🔌 Custom Providers Bring your own endpoint (Base URL + API key + models) or a local command template. Each provider has a connectivity test that checks reachability and auth, then makes one real vision call so you find out now, not mid-task. ### 📦 One-Click Install The settings page installs and updates the Claude Code plugin, the Codex role files and the Antigravity / Grok agents, skills and commands for you — marketplace registration, permission allowlist, HUD wiring, absolute paths rendered for this machine — and restores them just as easily. Every settings file is backed up first.
## How it works ``` Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Grok (orchestrator, keeps its own model) └─ ds-flash / ds-pro ← native subagent shell (progress shows in the host's task UI) └─ MCP: dsh_run_worker(tier, effort, cwd, worker=) ├─ worker="agy"/"grok" → that external CLI runs the task (explicit opt-in) ├─ hub reachable → session inside DSH (visible in the Web UI, grouped by cwd) └─ otherwise → dsh-jsonrpc-agent runtime (worker.cordis.yml) └─ DeepSeek V4 Flash / Pro (DSH SDK, event stream → progress and token stats) ``` ## One run, two views Dispatch fans out. Below, eighteen workers translate this README in parallel: the host counts them as its own subagents, while the harness runs them as real sessions.

Claude Code sees dsh-crew workers as native subagents, with a statusline segment tracking running tiers, elapsed time and tokens.

The DSH Crew panel sees the same run from the harness side: which host dispatched each job, its tier and effort, live progress and token usage.

The panel is also the jobs board: running and finished jobs stay listed with tier, progress and tokens, held workspaces name their holders, and a job that vanishes mid-flight (a hub restart) surfaces as an orphan ghost instead of disappearing silently.

## Install Install into a DSH profile from npm: ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add @zseven-w/dsh-crew@latest dsh web ``` Or, for local development straight from the source tree: ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-crew dsh web ``` The `link:` protocol symlinks the profile dependency to this repository, so rebuilds are visible immediately. ### Configure DeepSeek credentials (standalone only) In hub mode — the installation above — workers run inside the DSH instance and use the DeepSeek credentials it is already configured with. Nothing else to set up. Only the standalone fallback needs a key of its own: dispatching from a host with no DSH instance running launches a worker runtime as a separate process. Obtain an API key from [platform.deepseek.com](https://platform.deepseek.com) and write it to `~/.config/dsh-crew/.env`: ``` DEEPSEEK_API_KEY=sk-... ``` ### Verify ```bash node scripts/smoke.mjs ``` The smoke test dispatches one cheap job through whichever path is available — the hub when a DSH instance is running, s
